requirements.title: RCP_CMD_NOOP has value 0
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_NOOP shall have the numeric value 0. An uninitialized rcp_command_t.type shall be interpreted as a safe no-op.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_SET has value 1
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_SET shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_GET has value 2
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_GET shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_RESET has value 3
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_RESET shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_WATCHDOG has value 4
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_WATCHDOG shall have the numeric value 4. The watchdog kick command shall be a stable, named constant.

requirements.title: All rcp_command_type_t constants are distinct
requirements.text: RCP_CMD_NOOP, Set, Get, Reset, and Watchdog shall each have a different numeric value.

requirements.title: Zero-value rcp_command_t is a safe no-op
requirements.text: A zero-initialised rcp_command_t shall have zone=RCP_ZONE_UNKNOWN, type=RCP_CMD_NOOP, and priority=RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL.

requirements.title: rcp_command_t.payload may be empty
requirements.text: rcp_command_t.payload shall be optional; an empty payload shall be accepted by any rcp_controller_send() implementation without error or crash.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() returns StatusOK with no handler
requirements.text: When no handler callback is configured, rcp_controller_send() shall return a rcp_response_t with status=RCP_RESPONSE_OK.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() dispatches to the configured handler
requirements.text: When a handler callback is configured, rcp_controller_send() shall invoke the handler exactly once per rcp_controller_send() call and return the handler's rcp_response_t.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() rejected after close
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() called after rcp_controller_close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() respects an already-done context
requirements.text: If the rcp_context_t passed to rcp_controller_send() is already done at call time, rcp_controller_send() shall return RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT without invoking the handler.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_close() is idempotent
requirements.text: rcp_controller_close() shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall return a success return code without side effects.

requirements.title: Published rcp_status_t is delivered to all active subscribers
requirements.text: A rcp_status_t produced by rcp_mock_controller_publish() shall be received by every channel returned by an active rcp_controller_subscribe() call on the same controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe channels are closed when the controller closes
requirements.text: When rcp_controller_close() is called, all channels previously returned by rcp_controller_subscribe() shall be closed.

requirements.title: Subscribe rejected after close
requirements.text: rcp_controller_subscribe() called after rcp_controller_close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED. No channel shall be returned.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_zone() returns the declared zone
requirements.text: rcp_controller_zone() shall return the rcp_zone_t value provided at construction time for the lifetime of the controller.

requirements.title: Subscribe seq values are strictly increasing
requirements.text: Successive rcp_status_t updates received on a rcp_controller_subscribe() channel shall carry strictly increasing seq values.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel is closed when its context is done
requirements.text: When the rcp_context_t passed to rcp_controller_subscribe() becomes done, the channel returned by that rcp_controller_subscribe() call shall be closed.

requirements.title: Multiple concurrent subscribers each receive published rcp_status_t
requirements.text: When multiple rcp_controller_subscribe() calls are active on the same controller, each returned channel shall independently receive every rcp_status_t published via rcp_mock_controller_publish().

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_NOOP is accepted without error
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() with rcp_command_t.type=RCP_CMD_NOOP shall return RCP_RESPONSE_OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_WATCHDOG is accepted without error
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() with rcp_command_t.type=RCP_CMD_WATCHDOG shall return RCP_RESPONSE_OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: RCP_CMD_RESET is accepted without error
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() with rcp_command_t.type=RCP_CMD_RESET shall return RCP_RESPONSE_OK and shall not return an error.

requirements.title: handler callback rcp_response_t is returned verbatim
requirements.text: When a handler callback is configured, the rcp_response_t returned by the handler shall be returned directly by rcp_controller_send() without modification.

requirements.title: Publish on a closed controller does not crash
requirements.text: Calling rcp_mock_controller_publish() on a controller after rcp_controller_close() shall not throw or crash.

requirements.title: Concurrent rcp_controller_send() calls are data-race free
requirements.text: Multiple concurrent calls to rcp_controller_send() on the same controller shall be free of data races.

requirements.title: Concurrent rcp_mock_controller_publish() and rcp_controller_subscribe() are data-race free
requirements.text: Concurrent calls to rcp_mock_controller_publish() and rcp_controller_subscribe() on the same controller shall be free of data races.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries the correct rcp_zone_t
requirements.text: Every rcp_status_t received on a rcp_controller_subscribe() channel shall carry a zone field equal to the subscribing Controller's zone.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries correct Payload
requirements.text: rcp_status_t.payload on each received update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument of the rcp_mock_controller_publish() call that produced it.

requirements.title: Subscribe channel carries healthy=true for open controller
requirements.text: rcp_status_t.healthy shall be true on every update published while the controller is open.

requirements.title: Done context does not invoke handler
requirements.text: If the rcp_context_t passed to rcp_controller_send() is already done, the handler callback shall not be invoked.

requirements.title: Send with empty payload does not crash
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() with an empty rcp_command_t.payload shall not throw or crash.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() rejects commands whose zone does not match the controller zone
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() shall return RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH when cmd.zone does not equal the zone declared by the controller.

requirements.title: rcp_controller_send() copies rcp_command_t.payload before passing to the handler
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() shall copy rcp_command_t.payload before invoking the handler. Subsequent modification of the original payload by the caller shall not affect the bytes seen by the handler.

requirements.title: rcp_mock_controller_publish() copies the payload before embedding in rcp_status_t
requirements.text: rcp_mock_controller_publish() shall copy the payload argument before embedding it in the rcp_status_t value delivered to subscribers.

requirements.title: Monitor subscribes to all zones
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_t shall subscribe to each registered zone controller's Status stream on construction.

requirements.title: Dead event on initial deadline
requirements.text: The monitor shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for any zone that does not publish a Status within the configured deadline, including the very first deadline period.

requirements.title: Repeated dead events suppressed
requirements.text: The monitor shall not re-emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for a zone that is already known to be dead.

requirements.title: Alive event on first status
requirements.text: The monitor shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=true} when the first Status arrives for a previously-dead zone.

requirements.title: Deadline timer resets on status
requirements.text: Receipt of a Status shall reset the per-zone deadline timer.

requirements.title: alive() returns false before first status
requirements.text: Monitor::alive(z) shall return false for any zone that has not yet published a Status.

requirements.title: Close terminates watch threads
requirements.text: Monitor::close() shall signal all watch threads to stop.

requirements.title: Destructor joins threads
requirements.text: The Monitor destructor shall join all watch threads before returning.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_CLOSED is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_CLOSED shall be non-zero so callers can distinguish it from RCP_OK (success).

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_BUSY is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_BUSY shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: All sentinel errors are mutually distinct
requirements.text: RCP_ERR_CLOSED, RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND, RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS, RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT, RCP_ERR_BUSY, and RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH shall all be distinct rcp_errc_t values (different rcp_errc_t value).

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_CLOSED detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any return code returned by a closed Controller or Registry shall compare equal to RCP_ERR_CLOSED. Callers must be able to detect closed-entity conditions without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any return code returned for a missing zone lookup shall compare equal to RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any return code returned for a duplicate zone registration shall compare equal to RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any return code returned due to a context deadline expiry shall compare equal to RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH is a distinct non-zero sentinel error
requirements.text: RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH shall be non-zero and distinct from all other sentinel errors so callers can detect zone-misrouting without parsing error strings.

requirements.title: rcp_strerror() returns unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_errc_t constant, including RCP_OK.

requirements.title: No fault when no rules
requirements.text: When no rules are active, send() shall delegate to the inner controller unchanged.

requirements.title: Drop rule returns error without calling inner
requirements.text: A Drop rule shall cause send() to return an error without calling the inner controller.

requirements.title: Error rule returns RCP_RESPONSE_ERROR
requirements.text: An Error rule shall return {} (no error code) with the Response status set to RCP_RESPONSE_ERROR.

requirements.title: Slow rule adds configured latency
requirements.text: A Slow rule shall sleep for Rule::latency before delegating to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Count-based rule expires after N firings
requirements.text: A rule with count > 0 shall auto-expire after count applications and be removed from the active list.

requirements.title: clear_rules() removes all active rules
requirements.text: clear_rules() shall remove all rules, returning the controller to pass-through mode.

requirements.title: Timeout rule returns RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT
requirements.text: A Timeout rule shall return RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT without calling the inner controller.

requirements.title: zone() delegates to inner
requirements.text: zone() shall return the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The fault-injection controller's subscribe() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's subscribe().

requirements.title: close() delegates to inner and rejects further sends
requirements.text: The fault-injection controller's close() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's close() and mark the controller closed so subsequent send() calls return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: Permitted identity/zone/type combination succeeds
requirements.text: send() shall delegate to the inner controller when the caller's identity is permitted the command's zone and type by the access policy.

requirements.title: Denied identity returns RCP_ERR_FORBIDDEN
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_FORBIDDEN without calling the inner controller when the access policy denies the caller's identity.

requirements.title: Empty zone/type set means all allowed
requirements.text: A policy entry with an empty zone set or an empty command-type set shall permit all zones or all command types respectively for that identity.

requirements.title: AccessPolicy permits concurrently without data races
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall be safe to call concurrently with rcp_authz_policy_allow() from multiple threads.

requirements.title: zone() delegates to inner
requirements.text: zone() shall return the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: subscribe() shall delegate to the inner controller unchanged; access policy is only enforced on send().

requirements.title: close() delegates to inner
requirements.text: close() shall delegate to the inner controller.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_FORBIDDEN is a distinct error code
requirements.text: RCP_ERR_FORBIDDEN shall be a distinct rcp_errc_t value from every other defined error code.

requirements.title: Session starts in Idle state
requirements.text: A newly constructed rcp_firmware_session_t shall be in RCP_FW_STATE_IDLE.

requirements.title: initiate() transitions Idle to Initiated
requirements.text: A successful initiate() call shall transition the session from RCP_FW_STATE_IDLE to RCP_FW_STATE_INITIATED.

requirements.title: initiate() from non-Idle state fails
requirements.text: initiate() called from any state other than RCP_FW_STATE_IDLE shall return RCP_FW_ERR_BAD_STATE without sending a command.

requirements.title: transfer() requires Initiated state
requirements.text: transfer() called from any state other than RCP_FW_STATE_INITIATED shall return RCP_FW_ERR_BAD_STATE without sending a command.

requirements.title: verify()/activate() advance the state machine
requirements.text: A successful verify() shall transition to RCP_FW_STATE_VERIFYING and a successful activate() shall transition to RCP_FW_STATE_ACTIVATED.

requirements.title: transfer() splits the image into chunk_size segments
requirements.text: transfer() shall split the image into ceil(len / chunk_size) chunks, each at most chunk_size bytes.

requirements.title: rollback() resets session to Idle
requirements.text: A successful rollback() shall transition the session back to RCP_FW_STATE_IDLE regardless of its prior state.

requirements.title: transfer() invokes the progress callback once per chunk
requirements.text: If a progress callback is supplied, transfer() shall invoke it exactly once per chunk sent, with cumulative bytes_sent and the current chunk_index/total_chunks.

requirements.title: rcp_fw_strerror() returns unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_fw_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_fw_errc_t constant (100-103).

requirements.title: ZoneGroup::all() contains exactly 5 zones
requirements.text: rcp_zone_group_all() shall return a group containing front-left, front-right, rear-left, rear-right, and central, and no others.

requirements.title: send_group() dispatches concurrently to every zone in the group
requirements.text: rcp_zonegroup_send() shall dispatch the command to every zone in the group concurrently, not sequentially.

requirements.title: send_group() collects a per-zone result for every zone
requirements.text: The returned rcp_group_response_t shall contain exactly one result (response and error) for every zone in the group.

requirements.title: errors() lists every failing zone
requirements.text: rcp_group_response_errors() shall list every zone whose result carries a non-RCP_OK error, and no others.

requirements.title: ZoneGroup is a copyable value type
requirements.text: Assigning one rcp_zone_group_t to another shall produce an independent copy; mutating the copy via rcp_zone_group_add() shall not affect the original.

requirements.title: send_group() propagates the caller's context deadline
requirements.text: The rcp_context_t passed to rcp_zonegroup_send() shall be propagated unchanged to every per-zone send.

requirements.title: ProxyController enforces the latency budget
requirements.text: send() shall derive a deadline of now + latency_budget and use it (or the caller's own deadline, if tighter) when forwarding to the upstream controller.

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry lookup returns a working controller
requirements.text: A controller returned by rcp_registry_lookup() on a proxy registry shall forward send() calls to the upstream controller for that route.

requirements.title: deregister() closes the upstream controller
requirements.text: deregister() shall close the upstream controller for that zone and remove its route.

requirements.title: lookup of unknown zone returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND
requirements.text: rcp_registry_lookup() for a zone with no registered route shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: ProxyRegistry close() is idempotent
requirements.text: Calling close() on an already-closed proxy registry shall return RCP_OK without error.

requirements.title: ProxyController zone matches upstream
requirements.text: zone() shall return the upstream controller's zone.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to upstream
requirements.text: The proxy controller's subscribe() shall forward to the wrapped upstream controller's subscribe().

requirements.title: Primary succeeds, standby unused
requirements.text: While the primary controller answers send() successfully, the standby shall never be contacted.

requirements.title: Auto-promotes standby on RCP_ERR_CLOSED
requirements.text: When auto_promote is enabled and the active controller's send() returns RCP_ERR_CLOSED, the redundant controller shall promote the standby and retry.

requirements.title: Auto-promotes standby on RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT
requirements.text: When auto_promote is enabled and the active controller's send() returns RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT, the redundant controller shall promote the standby and retry.

requirements.title: Manual promote() switches the active controller
requirements.text: promote() shall switch the active controller from primary to standby, or from standby to primary.

requirements.title: Double promote() returns to primary
requirements.text: Calling promote() twice in succession shall return the active controller to the primary.

requirements.title: close() closes both controllers
requirements.text: close() shall close both the primary and the standby controller.

requirements.title: auto_promote=false disables automatic failover
requirements.text: When auto_promote is false, send() shall surface the active controller's error unchanged rather than promoting the standby.

requirements.title: zone() returns zone of the active controller
requirements.text: zone() shall return the zone of whichever controller (primary or standby) is currently active.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to the currently active controller
requirements.text: The redundancy controller's subscribe() shall forward to whichever of primary/standby is currently active.

requirements.title: Local controller preferred over lease
requirements.text: lookup() shall return the locally registered controller for a zone even when a remote lease also exists for it.

requirements.title: Expired lease returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND
requirements.text: lookup() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND for a zone whose only lease has passed its expires_at_ms deadline.

requirements.title: revoke_lease() removes an active lease
requirements.text: revoke_lease() shall remove the lease for a zone, after which lookup() for that zone returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND (absent a local registration).

requirements.title: Remote lease used when no local controller registered
requirements.text: lookup() shall return the leased remote controller for a zone that has no local registration.

requirements.title: local_id is preserved
requirements.text: rcp_federation_registry_local_id() shall return the local_id passed to rcp_federation_registry_new().

requirements.title: close() closes local and remote controllers
requirements.text: close() shall close every locally registered controller and every leased remote controller.

requirements.title: Closed registry returns RCP_ERR_CLOSED on lookup
requirements.text: lookup() on a closed federated registry shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: register_ctrl rejects duplicate zone
requirements.text: register_ctrl() shall return RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS when a local controller is already registered for that zone.

requirements.title: controllers() lists registered local controllers
requirements.text: The federation registry's controllers() shall return a retained reference to each locally-registered controller, up to the caller's capacity, and return the true count.

requirements.title: deregister() removes and closes the local controller
requirements.text: The federation registry's deregister() shall remove and close the local controller for the given zone, or return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND if none is registered there.

requirements.title: Span recorded on successful send
requirements.text: send() shall record exactly one span per call, carrying the command's zone and command type.

requirements.title: Multiple sends accumulate spans
requirements.text: InMemorySink shall accumulate one span per send() call across repeated calls, in order.

requirements.title: Span duration is non-negative
requirements.text: A recorded span's end timestamp shall never precede its start timestamp.

requirements.title: Span captures the send's error code
requirements.text: A recorded span's result field shall equal the error code returned by the wrapped send() call.

requirements.title: Noop sink does not crash
requirements.text: The default no-op metrics sink shall accept every record_span/record_gauge/record_counter call without side effects or crashing.

requirements.title: InMemorySink is thread-safe under concurrent spans
requirements.text: InMemorySink shall record every span from concurrent send() calls across multiple threads without data races or lost updates.

requirements.title: commands.total counter increments per send
requirements.text: Every send() call, successful or not, shall increment the rcp.commands.total counter by 1 for that command's zone.

requirements.title: commands.errors counter increments on failure
requirements.text: A send() call that returns a non-RCP_OK error shall additionally increment the rcp.commands.errors counter by 1 for that command's zone.

requirements.title: zone() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The observe controller's zone() shall return the wrapped inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The observe controller's subscribe() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's subscribe().

requirements.title: close() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The observe controller's close() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's close().

requirements.title: zones() returns a snapshot of registered controllers
requirements.text: zones() shall return one entry (marked registered) for every controller currently registered on the wrapped registry.

requirements.title: subscribe() registers a callback invoked by emit()
requirements.text: A callback registered via subscribe() shall be invoked for every subsequent emit() call.

requirements.title: emit() delivers to all subscribers
requirements.text: emit() shall invoke every registered subscriber callback, in registration order.

requirements.title: record_counter() accumulates every delta exactly once
requirements.text: record_counter() shall add delta to the named counter's running total exactly once per call, even under concurrent invocation from multiple threads.

requirements.title: AdminServer tolerates concurrent mutation without data races
requirements.text: record_counter() and emit() shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads without data races or lost updates.

requirements.title: metrics_text() renders Prometheus-format counter lines
requirements.text: metrics_text() shall render a '# TYPE <name> counter' line followed by '<name>{<labels>} <value>' for every recorded counter.

requirements.title: Distinct name+labels combinations are tracked separately
requirements.text: record_counter() calls with the same name but different labels shall accumulate into distinct counters.

requirements.title: emit() delivers the correct event type and zone
requirements.text: A subscriber callback shall observe the same event type and zone that were passed to emit().

requirements.title: Recording controller captures entries
requirements.text: Every send() through a recording controller shall append exactly one entry to its Record, capturing the command's type and the send's result.

requirements.title: Multiple sends produce sequential entries
requirements.text: N successive send() calls through a recording controller shall append N entries to its Record, in order.

requirements.title: write_binary creates a non-empty file
requirements.text: rcp_record_write_binary() shall write a non-empty file for a Record containing at least one entry.

requirements.title: Playback replays entries against a target controller
requirements.text: rcp_playback_run_all() shall send() every recorded entry's command to the target controller.

requirements.title: speed_factor of 0 disables inter-entry delays
requirements.text: A rcp_playback_config_t with speed_factor == 0.0 shall replay every entry back-to-back without pausing for the recorded inter-entry timing.

requirements.title: Entry timestamps are monotonically non-decreasing
requirements.text: Consecutive entries appended to the same Record shall have timestamp_ms values that never decrease.

requirements.title: Forwards inner send result unchanged
requirements.text: A recording controller's send() shall return the inner controller's result verbatim, and capture that same result in the appended entry.

requirements.title: Record tolerates concurrent appends
requirements.text: rcp_record's append path shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads without data races or lost entries.

requirements.title: zone() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The record controller's zone() shall return the wrapped inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The record controller's subscribe() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's subscribe().

requirements.title: close() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The record controller's close() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's close().

requirements.title: parse_json parses multiple zone entries
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall parse a manifest containing multiple zone entries, extracting each entry's zone and priority fields.

requirements.title: parse_json extracts the optional priority field
requirements.text: When a zone entry includes a priority field, rcp_config_parse_json() shall copy its string value into the corresponding manifest entry.

requirements.title: parse_json rejects unknown zone names
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall return RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE for a zone entry naming a zone not in the fixed 5-zone map.

requirements.title: load() registers one controller per manifest zone entry
requirements.text: rcp_config_load() shall register one mock controller for every zone entry in the parsed manifest.

requirements.title: load() returns RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS on duplicate zone entries
requirements.text: rcp_config_load() shall return RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS if the manifest names the same zone more than once.

requirements.title: Parse errors carry a descriptive message
requirements.text: On RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE, rcp_config_parse_json() shall write a human-readable description identifying the invalid input into the caller-supplied error buffer.

requirements.title: Schema registry add and lookup
requirements.text: rcp_schema_registry_add() followed by rcp_schema_registry_lookup() for the same schema id shall return the entry's name and fields as added.

requirements.title: Unknown schema lookup returns false
requirements.text: rcp_schema_registry_lookup() for a schema id that was never added shall return false without modifying *out.

requirements.title: encode() prepends schema_id big-endian
requirements.text: rcp_dynamic_payload_encode() shall prepend the 4-byte schema_id in big-endian (most-significant byte first) order to the payload data.

requirements.title: encode/decode round-trip preserves schema_id and data
requirements.text: Decoding a buffer produced by encode() shall reconstruct the original schema_id and data unchanged.

requirements.title: decode() of a too-short buffer returns a zeroed payload
requirements.text: rcp_dynamic_payload_decode() given fewer than 4 bytes shall return schema_id = 0 and empty data rather than reading out of bounds or erroring.

requirements.title: SchemaRegistry is thread-safe
requirements.text: rcp_schema_registry_add()/_lookup() shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads without data races or lost entries.

requirements.title: send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete gRPC backend is linked, send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED rather than transmitting an unencrypted or malformed frame.

requirements.title: zone() returns configured zone
requirements.text: zone() shall return the zone passed to rcp_grpc_controller_new(), regardless of backend availability.

requirements.title: subscribe() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete gRPC backend is linked, subscribe() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED.

requirements.title: close() returns no error
requirements.text: close() shall return RCP_OK even when no backend is linked.

requirements.title: send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete HTTP client backend is linked, send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED.

requirements.title: zone() returns configured zone
requirements.text: zone() shall return the zone passed to rcp_rest_controller_new(), regardless of backend availability.

requirements.title: subscribe() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete HTTP client backend is linked, subscribe() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED.

requirements.title: close() returns no error
requirements.text: close() shall return RCP_OK even when no backend is linked.

requirements.title: send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete SOME/IP backend is linked, send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED.

requirements.title: zone() returns configured zone

requirements.text: rcp_loan_controller_t::loan(n) shall return a zeroed byte vector of exactly n bytes.

requirements.text: loan() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED if the controller has been closed.

requirements.title: loan() returns error for negative size
requirements.text: loan() shall return an error if size < 0.

requirements.title: send_loaned() delegates to inner
requirements.text: send_loaned() shall delegate command delivery to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Loan RAII releases buffer to pool
requirements.text: When a Loan is destroyed without being sent, its destructor shall return the buffer to the pool.

requirements.title: Discoverer interface for zone discovery
requirements.text: rcp_mdns_discoverer_t shall define the abstract interface for mDNS-based zone controller discovery.

requirements.title: start() fires Added event for each discovered zone
requirements.text: Discoverer::start() shall invoke the callback with EventType::Added for each discovered ZoneInfo.

requirements.title: stop() terminates discovery
requirements.text: Discoverer::stop() shall cause the discoverer to stop emitting events.

requirements.title: StaticDiscoverer emits configured zones
requirements.text: StaticDiscoverer::start() shall emit all configured ZoneInfo entries synchronously before returning.

requirements.title: ZoneInfo carries host, port, and zone
requirements.text: ZoneInfo shall carry the rcp_zone_t, host string, port number, and service instance name.

requirements.title: instance_name follows _rcp._udp.local convention
requirements.text: make_instance_name() shall produce names of the form '<zone>.<host>._rcp._udp.local'.

requirements.title: Announcer interface for zone registration
requirements.text: rcp_mdns_Announcer shall define the abstract interface for announcing zone controllers via the local mDNS responder.

requirements.title: withdraw() removes mDNS record
requirements.text: Announcer::withdraw(z) shall remove the mDNS record for the given zone.

requirements.title: Higher priority dispatched first
requirements.text: rcp_prioqueue_controller_t shall dispatch RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL before RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH before RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL when multiple commands are queued.

requirements.title: FIFO within same priority
requirements.text: Commands with equal priority shall be dispatched in the order they were submitted (first-in, first-out).

requirements.title: Deadline respected per entry
requirements.text: If a queued command's context deadline expires before dispatch, send() shall return RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT.

requirements.title: done() context rejected
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT immediately if the provided context is already done.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_t mismatch rejected
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH if cmd.zone differs from the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: Subscribe delegates to inner
requirements.text: subscribe() shall delegate directly to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Close stops dispatch thread
requirements.text: close() shall stop the dispatch thread and cause subsequent send() calls to return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: send() after close returns RCP_ERR_CLOSED
requirements.text: Any send() call after close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL has value 0
requirements.text: RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of rcp_priority_t and the safe default for rcp_command_t fields left unset.

requirements.title: RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH is greater than RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL
requirements.text: The numeric value of RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH shall be strictly greater than RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL.

requirements.title: RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL is greater than RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH
requirements.text: The numeric value of RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL shall be strictly greater than RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH.

requirements.title: sleep() sends CmdSleep
requirements.text: rcp_powerstate_manager_t::sleep() shall send RCP_CMD_SLEEP to the target zone.

requirements.title: sleep() transitions Active→Sleeping
requirements.text: A successful sleep() call shall transition the zone from Active to Sleeping.

requirements.title: wake() sends CmdWake
requirements.text: rcp_powerstate_manager_t::wake() shall send RCP_CMD_WAKE to the target zone.

requirements.title: wake() transitions Sleeping→Active
requirements.text: A successful wake() call shall transition the zone from Sleeping or BusOff to Active.

requirements.title: Command failure yields BusOff
requirements.text: A send error during sleep() or wake() shall transition the zone to BusOff.

requirements.title: recover_loop retries BusOff zones
requirements.text: The background recovery loop shall periodically attempt wake() for every zone in the BusOff state.

requirements.title: state() is thread-safe
requirements.text: rcp_powerstate_manager_t::state(z) shall be safe to call concurrently with sleep(), wake(), or the recovery loop.

requirements.title: Close stops recovery loop
requirements.text: Manager::close() shall stop the background recovery thread without hanging.

requirements.title: rcp_power_state_string() returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp_power_state_string() shall return a unique, non-empty name for each defined rcp_power_state_t constant.

requirements.title: rcp_mock_registry_new() pre-populates all five standard zones
requirements.text: A Registry returned by rcp_mock_registry_new() shall contain controllers for RCP_ZONE_FRONT_LEFT, RCP_ZONE_FRONT_RIGHT, RCP_ZONE_REAR_LEFT, RCP_ZONE_REAR_RIGHT, and RCP_ZONE_CENTRAL.

requirements.title: Duplicate zone registration returns RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS
requirements.text: rcp_registry_register() for a zone that already has a registered controller shall return RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS.

requirements.title: Deregister removes the zone and closes its controller
requirements.text: rcp_registry_deregister() shall remove the controller for the given zone and call close on it. After deregistration, lookup for the same zone shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: Lookup returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND for an absent zone
requirements.text: rcp_registry_lookup() for a zone with no registered controller shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: rcp_registry_close() is idempotent
requirements.text: rcp_registry_close() shall be safe to call multiple times. Every call after the first shall succeed without side effects.

requirements.title: Controllers returns all currently registered controllers
requirements.text: rcp_registry_controllers() shall return exactly the set of controllers currently registered, with no duplicates and no omissions.

requirements.title: Register rejected after rcp_registry_close()
requirements.text: rcp_registry_register() called after rcp_registry_close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: Deregister returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND for a zone that was never registered
requirements.text: rcp_registry_deregister() for a zone with no registered controller shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: Registered controller is immediately retrievable via lookup
requirements.text: After a successful rcp_registry_register() call, rcp_registry_lookup() for the same zone shall return the registered controller without error.

requirements.title: rcp_registry_close() calls close on all registered controllers
requirements.text: rcp_registry_close() shall call close on every controller currently registered before returning.

requirements.title: Lookup on a closed Registry returns an error
requirements.text: rcp_registry_lookup() called after rcp_registry_close() shall return a non-success return code.

requirements.title: Deregister for an already-deregistered zone returns RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND
requirements.text: A second call to rcp_registry_deregister() for a zone that was already deregistered shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: rcp_registry_lookup() returns RCP_ERR_CLOSED when called on a closed registry
requirements.text: rcp_registry_lookup() called after rcp_registry_close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED specifically, not RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND.

requirements.title: rcp_response_t.command_id echoes the originating rcp_command_t.id
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() shall return a rcp_response_t whose command_id field equals the id field of the submitted rcp_command_t.

requirements.title: rcp_response_t.zone identifies the zone that processed the command
requirements.text: rcp_controller_send() shall return a rcp_response_t whose zone field equals the rcp_zone_t of the Controller that processed the command.

requirements.title: Zero-value rcp_response_t has RCP_RESPONSE_OK
requirements.text: A zero-initialised rcp_response_t shall have status=RCP_RESPONSE_OK (value 0).

requirements.title: Token bucket with configurable rate and burst
requirements.text: rcp_ratelimit_controller_t shall implement a token bucket with configurable rate (tokens/s) and burst capacity.

requirements.title: Tokens refilled based on elapsed time
requirements.text: The token bucket shall refill tokens proportionally to elapsed wall-clock time since the last take().

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_BUSY when bucket exhausted
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_BUSY immediately, without calling inner send(), when fewer than 1 token remains.

requirements.title: Critical commands exempt when configured
requirements.text: When Config::exempt_critical is true, RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL commands shall bypass the token bucket.

requirements.title: Non-critical commands not exempt
requirements.text: RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL and RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH commands shall always be subject to the token bucket.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_t mismatch rejected
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH if cmd.zone differs from the inner controller's zone.

requirements.title: Close stops sends
requirements.text: close() shall cause subsequent send() calls to return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: send() after close returns RCP_ERR_CLOSED
requirements.text: Any send() call after close() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: The rate-limit controller's subscribe() shall forward to the wrapped inner controller's subscribe().

requirements.title: In-process zero-copy delivery
requirements.text: rcp_shmem_controller_t::send() shall deliver commands to the ZoneServer without serialising to a byte buffer.

requirements.title: Custom handler invoked
requirements.text: If set_handler() has been called, the handler shall be invoked for each command; otherwise a default OK response is returned.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH on wrong zone
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH if cmd.zone differs from the server's zone.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_CLOSED after close()
requirements.text: send() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED after the Controller or ZoneServer has been closed.

requirements.title: publish() delivers to all subscribers
requirements.text: ZoneServer::publish() shall push the Status to every active StatusChannel.

requirements.title: Payload copied before handler
requirements.text: The controller shall copy the Command payload before passing it to the ZoneServer handler.

requirements.title: Registry lookup finds registered server
requirements.text: shmem::rcp_registry_lookup()() shall return the controller for a zone registered via add_server().

requirements.title: rcp_registry_close()() releases all controllers
requirements.text: rcp_registry_close()() shall close all registered controllers and cause subsequent lookup() to return RCP_ERR_CLOSED.

requirements.title: zone_server close() marks unhealthy and closes all subscriber channels
requirements.text: rcp_shmem_zone_server_close() shall mark the server closed (rcp_shmem_zone_server_ok() subsequently returns false) and close every currently-registered subscriber status channel.

requirements.title: zone_server ok() reflects closed state
requirements.text: rcp_shmem_zone_server_ok() shall return true before close() and false after close().

requirements.title: subscription watcher removes its channel from the server on controller close
requirements.text: When a shmem controller is closed while a subscription is active, the subscription's background watcher shall call rcp_shmem_zone_server_remove_sub() and close the subscriber's status channel.

requirements.title: registry controllers() lists registered servers
requirements.text: The shmem registry's controllers() shall return a retained reference to each registered server's controller, up to the caller's capacity, and return the true count.

requirements.title: registry deregister() removes and closes the registered controller
requirements.text: The shmem registry's deregister() shall remove and close the controller for the given zone, or return RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND if none is registered there.

requirements.title: send() returns OK by default
requirements.text: rcp_sim_controller_t::send() shall return RCP_RESPONSE_OK unless a fault has been injected.

requirements.title: zone() returns configured zone
requirements.text: rcp_sim_controller_t::zone() shall return the rcp_zone_t value from the Config struct.

requirements.title: Constant latency model
requirements.text: When LatencyModel::Constant is configured, send() shall sleep for exactly base_latency before returning.

requirements.title: Jitter latency model
requirements.text: When LatencyModel::Jitter is configured, send() shall sleep for a duration uniformly distributed in [base_latency, base_latency + jitter].

requirements.title: fault() causes send to fail
requirements.text: fault(ec) shall cause all subsequent send() calls to return ec instead of delegating to the handler.

requirements.title: recover() restores normal operation
requirements.text: recover() shall clear any injected fault and restore send() to OK responses.

requirements.title: Status published on interval
requirements.text: If Config::status_interval > 0, the simulator shall publish a Status on that cadence to all subscribers.

requirements.title: close() stops background threads
requirements.text: close() shall terminate the status and watchdog background threads without hanging.

requirements.title: rcp_status_t.zone identifies the publishing controller
requirements.text: Every rcp_status_t published by a Controller shall carry a zone field equal to the Controller's declared zone.

requirements.title: rcp_status_t.seq is monotonically increasing
requirements.text: Each successive rcp_status_t published by a given Controller instance shall have a seq value strictly greater than the previous one.

requirements.title: rcp_status_t.healthy is true while the controller is open
requirements.text: A rcp_status_t published by a Controller that has not yet been closed shall carry healthy=true.

requirements.title: rcp_status_t.payload carries the bytes passed to rcp_mock_controller_publish()
requirements.text: rcp_status_t.payload in every delivered rcp_status_t update shall be byte-for-byte identical to the payload argument supplied to the rcp_mock_controller_publish() call that produced it.

requirements.title: rcp_status_t.payload may be empty
requirements.text: rcp_mock_controller_publish() shall accept an empty payload without error or crash. The resulting rcp_status_t.payload shall be empty.

requirements.title: rcp_response_status_string() returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp_response_status_string() shall return a unique, non-empty, human-readable string for each defined rcp_response_status_t constant.

requirements.title: RCP_RESPONSE_OK has value 0
requirements.text: RCP_RESPONSE_OK shall have the numeric value 0. An uninitialized rcp_response_t.status shall be interpreted as success.

requirements.title: RCP_RESPONSE_ERROR has value 1
requirements.text: RCP_RESPONSE_ERROR shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: RCP_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT has value 2
requirements.text: RCP_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: RCP_RESPONSE_BUSY has value 3
requirements.text: RCP_RESPONSE_BUSY shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: All rcp_response_status_t constants are distinct
requirements.text: RCP_RESPONSE_OK, Error, Timeout, Busy, and Unknown shall each have a different numeric value.

requirements.title: Mutual TLS authentication
requirements.text: TLS transport shall require both client and server to present valid X.509 certificates.

requirements.title: Certificate verification by CA
requirements.text: Certificates shall be verified against the configured CA bundle; self-signed certs shall be rejected unless the CA is the cert itself.

requirements.title: Config::verify_peer=true by default
requirements.text: Certificate verification shall be enabled by default.

requirements.title: PEM file support
requirements.text: cert_file, key_file, and ca_file shall accept paths to PEM-formatted files.

requirements.title: Command frames encrypted
requirements.text: All Command and Response frames shall be encrypted in transit.

requirements.title: Status frames encrypted
requirements.text: All Status subscription frames shall be encrypted in transit.

requirements.title: TLS 1.2+ enforced
requirements.text: Connections with TLS protocol version below 1.2 shall be rejected.

requirements.title: Weak cipher suites disabled
requirements.text: NULL, RC4, EXPORT, and DES cipher suites shall be disabled.

requirements.title: close() terminates TLS session
requirements.text: close() shall perform a clean TLS shutdown before closing the underlying socket.

requirements.title: Error propagation
requirements.text: Any TLS handshake or I/O error shall be returned as a rcp_errc_t to the caller.

requirements.title: controller zone() returns the configured zone
requirements.text: The TLS controller's zone() shall return the zone passed to rcp_tls_controller_new(), matching every other transport's zone() contract.

requirements.title: zone_server stub surface is inert and non-crashing
requirements.text: rcp_tls_zone_server_new()/ok()/set_handler()/set_healthy()/publish()/close()/destroy() shall not crash when called (no OpenSSL backend is linked); ok() shall always return false, matching the documented stub contract.

requirements.title: registry controllers() returns zero (no backend linked)
requirements.text: The TLS registry's controllers() shall always return 0, consistent with lookup()/register()/deregister() all returning RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED.

requirements.title: SO_PRIORITY set per command priority
requirements.text: rcp_tsn_controller_t::send() shall set the SO_PRIORITY socket option proportional to the command's rcp_priority_t before sending.

requirements.title: PCPMap maps Normal/High/Critical to PCP values
requirements.text: The PCPMap struct shall provide separate PCP values for RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL, RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH, and RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL.

requirements.title: Critical mapped to highest PCP
requirements.text: RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL shall be mapped to PCP 7 by default.

requirements.title: High mapped to mid-range PCP
requirements.text: RCP_PRIORITY_HIGH shall be mapped to PCP 5 by default.

requirements.title: Normal mapped to low PCP
requirements.text: RCP_PRIORITY_NORMAL shall be mapped to PCP 2 by default.

requirements.title: subscribe() delegates to inner
requirements.text: subscribe() shall delegate directly to the inner controller without modifying socket priority.

requirements.title: Header magic bytes 'RC'
requirements.text: All wire frames shall begin with the two-byte sequence 0x52 ('R'), 0x43 ('C').

requirements.title: Protocol version field
requirements.text: All wire frames shall carry the protocol version (currently 0x01) in byte 2.

requirements.title: Message type field
requirements.text: Byte 3 of every wire frame shall encode the message type: Command, Response, Status, Subscribe, or Unsubscribe.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_t field
requirements.text: Bytes 4 of every wire frame shall encode the target rcp_zone_t as a uint8.

requirements.title: rcp_command_type_t field for commands
requirements.text: Bytes 5–6 of Command frames shall encode the rcp_command_type_t as a big-endian uint16.

requirements.title: Priority/Status field
requirements.text: Byte 7 shall encode Priority for Command frames, rcp_response_status_t for Response frames, and Healthy flag for Status frames.

requirements.title: Command/response ID field
requirements.text: Bytes 8–11 shall encode the Command or Response ID as a big-endian uint32.

requirements.title: Payload length field
requirements.text: Bytes 12–15 shall encode the payload byte count as a big-endian uint32.

requirements.title: Payload follows header
requirements.text: The variable-length payload shall immediately follow the 16-byte header.

requirements.title: Big-endian multi-byte fields
requirements.text: All multi-byte fields in wire frames shall be encoded in big-endian (network) byte order.

requirements.title: Frame validation rejects bad magic
requirements.text: The decoder shall return an error if frame bytes 0–1 are not 0x52, 0x43.

requirements.title: Frame validation rejects bad version
requirements.text: The decoder shall return an error if the version byte does not equal the supported protocol version.

requirements.title: Frame decoders reject an oversized body_len before any length arithmetic
requirements.text: rcp_wire_decode_command()/_response()/_status() shall reject any body_len exceeding RCP_WIRE_MAX_PAYLOAD before computing RCP_WIRE_HEADER_LEN + body_len, so that no size_t-width-dependent integer overflow can bypass the short-frame length check on attacker-controlled input.

requirements.title: rcp_wire_strerror() returns unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_wire_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_wire_errc_t constant, including RCP_WIRE_OK.

requirements.title: controller zone() returns the configured zone
requirements.text: The UDP controller's zone() shall return the zone passed to rcp_udp_controller_new().

requirements.title: zone_server addr_string() returns the bound address
requirements.text: rcp_udp_zone_server_addr_string() shall format the server's actual bound local address as "ip:port" once the socket is open, or return 0 if the server is not open.

requirements.title: zone_server set_healthy() affects subsequently published status
requirements.text: rcp_udp_zone_server_set_healthy() shall change the healthy flag embedded in every Status published afterward via rcp_udp_zone_server_publish().

requirements.title: closing a subscription removes it from both controller and server subscriber lists
requirements.text: When a subscriber's status channel is closed without closing the whole controller, the controller's background watcher shall remove the channel from its own subscriber list and send an Unsubscribe control frame so the zone server removes the matching address from its own subscriber list.

requirements.title: registry dial() connects and registers a real UDP controller
requirements.text: rcp_udp_registry_dial() shall construct a UDP controller for the given zone/host/port, verify it is usable, and register it into the given registry, returning RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND if the controller cannot be constructed or is not usable.

requirements.title: Keeper kicks all zones periodically
requirements.text: rcp_watchdog_keeper_t shall send a CmdWatchdog command to every registered zone controller at the configured interval.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_t starts Healthy
requirements.text: A zone controller shall be in the Healthy state immediately after Keeper construction.

requirements.title: Degraded after degrade_after misses
requirements.text: A zone controller shall transition to Degraded after degrade_after consecutive kick failures.

requirements.title: Faulted after fault_after misses
requirements.text: A zone controller shall transition to Faulted after fault_after consecutive kick failures.

requirements.title: Recovery to Healthy on success
requirements.text: A zone controller shall transition back to Healthy on the next successful kick after any degraded or faulted state.

requirements.title: Callback fires on transition
requirements.text: The health callback shall be invoked with the new HealthState whenever a zone's health state changes.

requirements.title: Kick timeout respected
requirements.text: Each kick shall use a rcp_context_t with the configured timeout; a timeout response shall count as a miss.

requirements.title: Close stops background thread
requirements.text: Keeper::close() shall cause the background kick thread to terminate without hanging.

requirements.title: rcp_health_state_string() returns unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp_health_state_string() shall return a unique, non-empty name for each defined rcp_health_state_t constant.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_string() returns unique PascalCase name
requirements.text: rcp_zone_string() shall return a unique, non-empty, PascalCase string (e.g. "FrontLeft") for each defined rcp_zone_t constant, per RELAY spec routing conventions. Two distinct rcp_zone_t constants shall never return the same string.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_UNKNOWN has value 0
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_UNKNOWN shall have the numeric value 0, making it the zero value of the rcp_zone_t type and a safe default for uninitialized variables.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_FRONT_LEFT has value 1
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_FRONT_LEFT shall have the numeric value 1.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_FRONT_RIGHT has value 2
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_FRONT_RIGHT shall have the numeric value 2.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_REAR_LEFT has value 3
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_REAR_LEFT shall have the numeric value 3.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_REAR_RIGHT has value 4
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_REAR_RIGHT shall have the numeric value 4.

requirements.title: RCP_ZONE_CENTRAL has value 5
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_CENTRAL shall have the numeric value 5.

requirements.title: All named rcp_zone_t constants are distinct
requirements.text: RCP_ZONE_FRONT_LEFT, RCP_ZONE_FRONT_RIGHT, RCP_ZONE_REAR_LEFT, RCP_ZONE_REAR_RIGHT, and RCP_ZONE_CENTRAL shall each have a different numeric value from every other named zone constant.

requirements.title: rcp_zone_from_string() reverses rcp_zone_string(), accepts legacy form
requirements.text: rcp_zone_from_string() shall return the rcp_zone_t constant matching a zone name previously returned by rcp_zone_string() (PascalCase), shall also accept the legacy kebab-case form for backward compatibility, and shall return RCP_ZONE_UNKNOWN for NULL or an unrecognized string.

requirements.title: rcp_wallclock_ms() returns wall-clock epoch milliseconds
requirements.text: rcp_wallclock_ms() shall return the number of milliseconds elapsed since the Unix epoch, per the host's wall-clock (calendar) time source.

requirements.title: relay_protocol_string() returns a unique name per protocol
requirements.text: relay_protocol_string() shall return a unique, non-empty string for each defined relay_protocol_t constant, matching the RELAY spec's protocol identifier names (e.g. "RCP").

requirements.title: relay_message_t lifecycle: init, free, set_id are safe and non-leaking
requirements.text: relay_message_init() shall zero a relay_message_t to a safely-freeable state; relay_message_free() shall release all owned fields (id, payload, meta) and be safe to call repeatedly; relay_message_set_id() shall deep-copy the given id, replacing (and freeing) any prior value.

requirements.title: relay_message_t meta map: set upserts, get looks up, both deep-copy
requirements.text: relay_message_set_meta() shall deep-copy key and value, replacing any existing entry with the same key rather than appending a duplicate; relay_message_get_meta() shall return the value for a given key, or NULL if absent.

requirements.title: rcp_status_to_message() maps Status fields per §15.7.5
requirements.text: rcp_status_to_message() shall set protocol to RCP, id to the zone's PascalCase name, payload to a copy of the status payload, seq to the status sequence number, timestamp_ms to the current wall-clock time, and meta["rcp.healthy"] to "true" or "false".

requirements.title: rcp_response_to_message() maps Response fields per §15.7.5
requirements.text: rcp_response_to_message() shall set protocol to RCP, id to the zone's PascalCase name, payload to a copy of the response payload, and meta["rcp.status"] to the decimal string of the response status.

requirements.title: rcp_message_to_command() maps Message fields per §15.7.5
requirements.text: rcp_message_to_command() shall set zone from the message id (via rcp_zone_from_string), priority from meta["rcp.priority"] ("high"/"critical"/else Normal), type from meta["rcp.cmd_type"] ("set"/"get"/"reset"/"watchdog"/"sleep"/"wake"/else Noop), and payload borrowed from the message payload.

requirements.title: Adapter send() maps and dispatches, discarding the response
requirements.text: The relay Caller adapter's send() shall convert the given message to a Command, dispatch it via the wrapped controller's send(), and return the resulting error code while discarding the Response payload.

requirements.title: Adapter call() maps request, dispatches, and maps the reply back
requirements.text: The relay Caller adapter's call() shall convert the given request message to a Command, dispatch it via the wrapped controller's send(), and on success convert the resulting Response to a Message.

requirements.title: Adapter subscribe() forwards Status as Message via a per-subscription thread
requirements.text: The relay Caller adapter's subscribe() shall subscribe to the wrapped controller's Status channel and spawn one thread per subscription that converts each Status to a Message and pushes it to the returned channel, closing the returned channel when the underlying Status channel closes.

requirements.title: Adapter subscribe() applies the requested back-pressure policy
requirements.text: The subscription thread shall apply DropNewest (discard the incoming message if the channel is full), DropOldest (evict the oldest queued message to make room), or Block (retry until space is available or the channel closes) per the caller's SubscriberOptions.

requirements.title: rcp_adapt() wraps a controller without blocking or connecting
requirements.text: rcp_adapt() shall retain the given controller and return a relay Caller wrapping it immediately, without blocking or establishing any connection.

requirements.title: RCP_SPEC_VERSION aliases RELAY_SPEC_VERSION
requirements.text: RCP_SPEC_VERSION shall be defined and shall equal RELAY_SPEC_VERSION, per the RELAY spec's required package-level SpecVersion export (§17 requirement 12, §19.4).

requirements.title: relay_strerror() returns unique human-readable message
requirements.text: relay_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined relay_errc_t constant.

requirements.title: version command emits a schema-conformant document
requirements.text: rcp_cli_run() shall, given the 'version' command, print a document (JSON or text per --format) containing the tool name, RCP_VERSION, RELAY_SPEC_VERSION, and language/runtime fields, conforming to RELAY spec/schemas/cli-version.json.

requirements.title: capabilities command emits a schema-conformant document
requirements.text: rcp_cli_run() shall, given the 'capabilities' command, always print a JSON document listing the tool's implemented commands (including at least version/capabilities/status), transports, interfaces, and adapt status, conforming to RELAY spec/schemas/cli-capabilities.json.

requirements.title: status command emits a schema-conformant document
requirements.text: rcp_cli_run() shall, given the 'status' command, print a document (JSON or text per --format) containing tool/version/healthy/connected/endpoint/details fields, conforming to RELAY spec/schemas/cli-status.json, and shall return exit code 0 when healthy.

requirements.title: Unknown command or missing argument returns exit code 2
requirements.text: rcp_cli_run() shall return RCP_CLI_INVALID_ARGS (2) for an empty argument list, an unrecognized command, or an unrecognized/incomplete --format value, per RELAY spec §11.3 exit code conventions.

requirements.title: --format text|json selects the document encoding
requirements.text: rcp_cli_run() shall default to text output when --format is absent, honor --format json / --format text when present, and reject any other --format value.

requirements.title: CLI entry point forwards process arguments to rcp_cli_run()
requirements.text: The c-rcp executable's main() shall forward argv[1..argc) and stdout/stderr to rcp_cli_run() unmodified and return its exit code, per the RELAY spec's CLI contract (§11.3).

requirements.title: Heap swap/sift-down reorder pending entries by priority
requirements.text: When more than one command is pending in the priority queue, popping the next entry for dispatch shall re-heapify the remaining entries so the highest-priority (then oldest) entry is dispatched next.

requirements.title: Gauge sink implementations accept a metric without side effects beyond recording
requirements.text: Both the noop and in-memory metrics sink implementations shall accept a record_gauge() call for any rcp_metric_t without crashing.

requirements.title: Power-state manager grows its callback list on demand
requirements.text: rcp_powerstate_manager_subscribe() shall append the caller's callback to the manager's internal list, growing its backing storage as needed, and return false only on allocation failure.

requirements.title: Announcer destroy dispatches through its vtable
requirements.text: rcp_mdns_announcer_destroy() shall invoke the announcer's vtable destroy() function and shall be a no-op when passed NULL.

requirements.title: Relay caller retain increments refcount and returns the same pointer
requirements.text: rcp_relay_caller_retain() shall increment the caller's refcount and return the same pointer passed in, and shall be a no-op returning NULL when passed NULL.

requirements.title: Message channel reports its closed state
requirements.text: relay_message_channel_is_closed() shall report whether the channel has been closed, reflecting the state set by its close operation.

requirements.title: Sim controller removes a subscriber from its internal list on teardown
requirements.text: When a sim controller's status-channel watcher tears down while the controller is still open, it shall remove the channel from the controller's internal subscriber list before releasing its reference.

requirements.title: Sim controller reports watchdog-missed based on last kick time
requirements.text: rcp_sim_controller_watchdog_missed() shall return true if the watchdog has never been kicked or the elapsed time since the last kick meets or exceeds the configured timeout, and false otherwise; it shall always return false when watchdog_timeout_ms is 0.

requirements.title: Proxy registry lists registered upstream controllers
requirements.text: rcp_registry_controllers() on a proxy registry shall return the number of registered upstream controllers and populate the output array (up to cap) with retained references to them.

requirements.title: Span duration is computed as end minus start
requirements.text: rcp_span_duration_ms() shall return the difference between a span's end_ms and start_ms timestamps.

requirements.title: Native errors report equivalence to RELAY common-error sentinels
requirements.text: rcp_errc_to_relay_errc() shall report true and the corresponding relay_errc_t for RCP_ERR_CLOSED and RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT, and false for RCP_OK and any rcp_errc_t value with no RELAY common-error equivalent.

requirements.title: NTSCF AVTP subtype value
requirements.text: The AVTPDU subtype byte (offset 0) of every NTSCF header shall equal RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF (0x82), the IEEE 1722 base-standard subtype for the Non-Time-Synchronous Control Format.

requirements.title: TSCF AVTP subtype value
requirements.text: The AVTPDU subtype byte (offset 0) of every TSCF header shall equal RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF (0x05), the IEEE 1722 base-standard subtype for the Time-Synchronous Control Format.

requirements.title: NTSCF header round-trip
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_ntscf() applied to the output of rcp_avtp_encode_ntscf() shall recover the original sv, version, sequence_num, stream_id, and payload bytes unchanged.

requirements.title: TSCF header round-trip
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_tscf() applied to the output of rcp_avtp_encode_tscf() shall recover the original sv, version, mr, tv, tu, sequence_num, stream_id, avtp_timestamp, and payload bytes unchanged.

requirements.title: NTSCF decode rejects a frame shorter than the fixed header
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_ntscf() shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME if given fewer than RCP_AVTP_NTSCF_HEADER_LEN bytes.

requirements.title: TSCF decode rejects a frame shorter than the fixed header
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_tscf() shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME if given fewer than RCP_AVTP_TSCF_HEADER_LEN bytes.

requirements.title: NTSCF decode rejects a mismatched subtype
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_ntscf() shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_BAD_SUBTYPE if byte 0 of the input is not RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF, including when it is RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF.

requirements.title: TSCF decode rejects a mismatched subtype
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_tscf() shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_BAD_SUBTYPE if byte 0 of the input is not RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF, including when it is RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF.

requirements.title: Decoders reject a declared payload length exceeding the supplied buffer
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_decode_ntscf() and rcp_avtp_decode_tscf() shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME whenever the header's declared data-length field describes a payload extending past the end of the supplied buffer.

requirements.title: stream_id packs to and unpacks from its 64-bit on-wire form
requirements.text: rcp_stream_id_from_u64(rcp_stream_id_to_u64(id)) shall recover a stream_id equal (per rcp_stream_id_equal()) to the original id for any MAC and unique_id, and rcp_stream_id_make() shall construct a stream_id from a given MAC and unique_id unchanged.

requirements.title: stream_id equality compares both MAC and unique_id
requirements.text: rcp_stream_id_equal() shall return false if either the MAC or the unique_id differs between its two arguments, and true only if both match.

requirements.title: AVTP address equality requires a matching byte_bus_id, not just stream_id
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_addr_equal() shall return false for two addresses that share a stream_id but differ in byte_bus_id, and true only when both the stream_id and byte_bus_id match.

requirements.title: rcp_avtp_peek_subtype() reads the subtype byte without a full header
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_peek_subtype() shall report the AVTPDU's subtype byte (offset 0) from a buffer as short as 1 byte, and shall return RCP_AVTP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a zero-length buffer.

requirements.title: TSCF-without-time-sync is unconditionally dropped
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_should_drop_tscf() shall return true if and only if subtype equals RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF and server_time_sync_supported is false; it shall return false for RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF regardless of server_time_sync_supported, and false for RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF when server_time_sync_supported is true.

requirements.title: rcp_avtp_strerror() returns a unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_avtp_errc_t constant, including RCP_AVTP_OK.

requirements.title: AVTP transport refcounting releases exactly at zero
requirements.text: rcp_avtp_transport_retain() shall increment a transport's refcount and return the same pointer; rcp_avtp_transport_release() shall invoke the transport's destroy() callback only once its refcount reaches zero, and never before.

requirements.title: Loopback transport delivers frames in FIFO order
requirements.text: A frame enqueued via the loopback transport's send() shall be returned by a subsequent recv() unchanged and in the same relative order as other queued frames.

requirements.title: Loopback transport recv() honors a context deadline
requirements.text: The loopback transport's recv() shall return RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT if no frame becomes available before the given rcp_context_t's deadline elapses.

requirements.title: Loopback transport rejects operations after close()
requirements.text: After the loopback transport's close() has been called, send() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED, and recv() shall return RCP_ERR_CLOSED once any already-queued frames are exhausted.

requirements.title: Loopback transport enforces its configured queue capacity
requirements.text: The loopback transport's send() shall return RCP_ERR_BUSY once the number of undelivered queued frames reaches the capacity given to rcp_avtp_loopback_transport_new().

requirements.title: rcp_acf_strerror() returns a unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_acf_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_acf_errc_t constant, including RCP_ACF_OK.

requirements.title: Response classification selects among Acknowledge/Write/Read/Error
requirements.text: rcp_acf_classify_response() shall return RCP_ACF_RESP_ERROR whenever hdr->err is set regardless of hdr->op, and otherwise shall return RCP_ACF_RESP_WRITE for RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, RCP_ACF_RESP_READ for RCP_ACF_OP_READ, and RCP_ACF_RESP_ACKNOWLEDGE for RCP_ACF_OP_NONE.

requirements.title: Acknowledge-with-event identification
requirements.text: rcp_acf_hdr_ack_has_event() shall return true if and only if hdr classifies as RCP_ACF_RESP_ACKNOWLEDGE (per rcp_acf_classify_response()) and hdr->evt is nonzero.

requirements.title: Encoders write the correct acf_msg_type regardless of the caller-supplied header
requirements.text: rcp_acf_encode_abb() shall write RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB and rcp_acf_encode_gbb() shall write RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB at offset 0 of the encoded message, independent of any acf_msg_type value the caller's header struct happens to carry.

requirements.title: Decoders reject a frame shorter than the fixed header
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_abb() shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_SHORT_FRAME if given fewer than RCP_ACF_ABB_HEADER_LEN bytes, and rcp_acf_decode_gbb() shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_SHORT_FRAME if given fewer than RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN bytes.

requirements.title: acf_msg_length is recomputed from the actual payload length on encode
requirements.text: rcp_acf_encode_abb() and rcp_acf_encode_gbb() shall derive the encoded acf_msg_length field from payload_len, ignoring any acf_msg_length value present in the caller-supplied header.

requirements.title: ACF_ABB decode rejects a mismatched acf_msg_type
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_abb() shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE if byte 0 of the input is not RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB, including when it is RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB.

requirements.title: ACF_GBB decode rejects a mismatched acf_msg_type
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_gbb() shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE if byte 0 of the input is not RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB, including when it is RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB.

requirements.title: Decoders reject a declared payload length exceeding the supplied buffer
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_abb() and rcp_acf_decode_gbb() shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_SHORT_FRAME whenever the header's declared acf_msg_length describes a payload extending past the end of the supplied buffer.

requirements.title: byte_message_info header round-trip
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_abb() applied to the output of rcp_acf_encode_abb(), and rcp_acf_decode_gbb() applied to the output of rcp_acf_encode_gbb(), shall each recover the original byte_bus_id, evt, op, transaction_num, and payload bytes unchanged, and rcp_acf_decode_gbb() shall additionally recover the original message_timestamp unchanged whenever mtv indicates a valid timestamp.

requirements.title: ACF_GBB encode zeroes the timestamp region for an untimed message
requirements.text: rcp_acf_encode_gbb() shall write an all-zero message_timestamp region whenever hdr->info.mtv equals RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, regardless of the value held in hdr->message_timestamp.

requirements.title: Timestamp-validity folding rule
requirements.text: rcp_acf_gbb_is_timed() shall return true only when info.mtv equals RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID; it shall return false for both RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED and RCP_ACF_MTV_UNCERTAIN, folding the uncertain ('tu') state into the same not-confidently-timed treatment as untimed.

requirements.title: rcp_acf_peek_msg_type() reads the acf_msg_type byte without a full header decode
requirements.text: rcp_acf_peek_msg_type() shall report the ACF message's acf_msg_type byte (offset 0) from a buffer as short as 1 byte, and shall return RCP_ACF_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a zero-length buffer.

requirements.title: Encoded ACF_ABB/ACF_GBB message length matches header length plus payload
requirements.text: rcp_acf_encode_abb() shall produce a frame of exactly RCP_ACF_ABB_HEADER_LEN + payload_len bytes, and rcp_acf_encode_gbb() shall produce a frame of exactly RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN + payload_len bytes, with RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN equal to RCP_ACF_ABB_HEADER_LEN plus the 8-byte message_timestamp field.

requirements.title: byte_message_info round-trips its remaining flag and count fields unchanged
requirements.text: rcp_acf_decode_abb() and rcp_acf_decode_gbb() shall recover the original pad, hs, cs, rsp, err, ms, and read_size_or_segment_num field values unchanged from what rcp_acf_encode_abb()/rcp_acf_encode_gbb() encoded.

requirements.title: Lifecycle states have their defined on-wire byte values
requirements.text: RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED, RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED, and RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED shall have the numeric values 0x00, 0x55, and 0xAA respectively.

requirements.title: HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT triggers on a missing HW pin mapping
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_hw_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT whenever any endpoint with ep_used set has hw_pin_mapped unset, regardless of the state of any other endpoint.

requirements.title: HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT triggers on a missing configured request stream
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_hw_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT whenever any endpoint with ep_used set has has_request_stream unset.

requirements.title: HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT does not trigger when every used endpoint is plausibly configured
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_hw_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK when every endpoint with ep_used set has both hw_pin_mapped and has_request_stream set, ignoring endpoints with ep_used unset, and shall treat a NULL snapshot as inconsistent rather than vacuously plausible.

requirements.title: RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT triggers on a missing stream/byte_bus_id association
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_rcp_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT whenever any endpoint with ep_used set has has_stream_assoc unset.

requirements.title: RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT triggers on a request stream missing its response stream
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_rcp_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT whenever any request stream with configured set has has_response_stream unset.

requirements.title: RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT does not trigger when every used endpoint and configured request stream is plausibly associated
