requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_check_rcp_cfg() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK when every endpoint with ep_used set has has_stream_assoc set and every request stream with configured set has has_response_stream set, and shall treat a NULL snapshot as inconsistent rather than vacuously plausible.

requirements.title: HW_UNCONFIGURED to HW_CONFIGURED is gated by the HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT check
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall move *state from RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED to RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED only when rcp_lifecycle_check_hw_cfg() returns RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK for the supplied snapshot, and shall otherwise leave *state unchanged and return the check's RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT result.

requirements.title: HW_CONFIGURED to RCP_CONFIGURED is gated by the RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT check
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall move *state from RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED to RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED only when rcp_lifecycle_check_rcp_cfg() returns RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK for the supplied snapshot, and shall otherwise leave *state unchanged and return the check's RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT result.

requirements.title: HW_CONFIGURED to HW_UNCONFIGURED demotion is unconditional
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall move *state from RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED to RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED and return RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK regardless of the supplied snapshot, including a NULL snapshot.

requirements.title: RCP_CONFIGURED to HW_UNCONFIGURED full-reset demotion is unconditional
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall move *state from RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED to RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED and return RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK regardless of the supplied snapshot, including a NULL snapshot.

requirements.title: Unmodeled lifecycle transitions are rejected
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION and leave *state unchanged for any requested transition other than HW_UNCONFIGURED->HW_CONFIGURED, HW_CONFIGURED->RCP_CONFIGURED, HW_CONFIGURED->HW_UNCONFIGURED, RCP_CONFIGURED->HW_UNCONFIGURED, or a same-state transition -- including HW_UNCONFIGURED->RCP_CONFIGURED and RCP_CONFIGURED->HW_CONFIGURED.

requirements.title: A same-state lifecycle transition is a no-op success
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_transition() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK and leave *state unchanged whenever target equals the current *state, for all three lifecycle states, regardless of the supplied snapshot.

requirements.title: HW_UNCONFIGURED accepts an ACF_ABB request at the discovery byte_bus_id under NTSCF
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_should_accept() shall return true for RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED when avtp_subtype is RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF, acf_msg_type is RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB, and byte_bus_id equals RCP_LIFECYCLE_DISCOVERY_BYTE_BUS_ID.

requirements.title: HW_UNCONFIGURED silently drops everything but the discovery ACF_ABB request
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_should_accept() shall return false for RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED whenever avtp_subtype is not RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_NTSCF, acf_msg_type is not RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB, or byte_bus_id does not equal RCP_LIFECYCLE_DISCOVERY_BYTE_BUS_ID.

requirements.title: HW_UNCONFIGURED drops any TSCF-headed frame regardless of time-sync support
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_should_accept() shall return false for RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED whenever avtp_subtype is RCP_AVTP_SUBTYPE_TSCF, regardless of the value of time_sync_supported.

requirements.title: HW_CONFIGURED and RCP_CONFIGURED apply the ordinary TSCF/time-sync drop rule
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_should_accept() shall return false for RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED and RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED whenever rcp_avtp_should_drop_tscf() would return true for the given time_sync_supported and avtp_subtype, and shall otherwise return true for those two states.

requirements.title: HW_GENERIC fields become read-only once HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_field_writable() shall return true for RCP_LIFECYCLE_FIELD_HW_GENERIC only when state is RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED, for every writer context, and shall return false for that field kind in both RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED and RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED.

requirements.title: FUNCTIONAL_W fields require an authorized writer once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_field_writable() shall return true for RCP_LIFECYCLE_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W in RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED for every writer context, shall return false in RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED for every writer context, and shall return true in RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED if and only if writer.via_root_client_ep0 or writer.via_owning_stream is true.

requirements.title: FUNCTIONAL_W_STAR fields are permanently locked once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_field_writable() shall return false for RCP_LIFECYCLE_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W_STAR in RCP_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED for every writer context, including one with both via_root_client_ep0 and via_owning_stream set, while returning true for that field kind in RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED.

requirements.title: A disabled endpoint queues submitted requests instead of executing them
requirements.text: rcp_server_endpoint_submit() shall return false and append a copy of the submitted request to ep's queue (incrementing the value rcp_server_endpoint_queue_len() reports) whenever ep->ep_enable is false at the time of the call.

requirements.title: An enabled endpoint reports immediate execution without touching its queue
requirements.text: rcp_server_endpoint_submit() shall return true and leave rcp_server_endpoint_queue_len() unchanged whenever ep->ep_enable is true at the time of the call.

requirements.title: Re-enabling an endpoint drains its queued requests in FIFO order
requirements.text: rcp_server_endpoint_drain_one() shall return false and leave the queue untouched while ep->ep_enable is false, and after rcp_server_endpoint_set_enable() sets ep->ep_enable to true, repeated calls to rcp_server_endpoint_drain_one() shall dequeue every previously-queued request in the same order it was submitted, returning false once the queue is empty.

requirements.title: rcp_lifecycle_strerror() returns a unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_lifecycle_strerror() shall return a distinct, non-empty, non-NULL string for each of RCP_LIFECYCLE_OK, RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_HW_CFG_INCONSISTENT, RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_RCP_CFG_INCONSISTENT, and RCP_LIFECYCLE_ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_is_ep0() identifies EP0 by index
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_is_ep0() shall return true if and only if ep_index equals RCP_REGMAP_EP0_INDEX.

requirements.title: EP0 shares its index with the discovery byte_bus_id
requirements.text: RCP_REGMAP_EP0_INDEX shall equal RCP_SERVER_DISCOVERY_BYTE_BUS_ID, since EP0 and the discovery channel are reached through the same address.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_general_init() zero-initializes with no root client granted
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_general_init() shall set every field of its argument to zero except svr_root_client_index, which it shall set to RCP_REGMAP_NO_ROOT_CLIENT.

requirements.title: svr_implemented_options bit assignments are pairwise distinct
requirements.text: The six RCP_REGMAP_OPT_* bitmask constants (time-sync, enhanced-cancel, and compound-bundles groups) shall each occupy a distinct bit position.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() accepts an all-clear options value
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() shall return true when options is 0.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() accepts a fully-set feature group
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() shall return true when options has every bit of one or more of the time-sync, enhanced-cancel, or compound-bundles groups set together.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() rejects a partially-set feature group
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() shall return false when options has exactly one bit of any of the three feature groups set without that group's other bit.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() accepts multiple independently-complete groups
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_options_group_consistent() shall return true when options has two or more of the three feature groups fully set at once.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() grants via_root_client_ep0 for the root client through EP0
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() shall set via_root_client_ep0 true when via_ep0 is true, svr_root_client_index is not RCP_REGMAP_NO_ROOT_CLIENT, and requesting_stream_index equals svr_root_client_index.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() withholds via_root_client_ep0 while no root client is granted
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() shall set via_root_client_ep0 false whenever svr_root_client_index equals RCP_REGMAP_NO_ROOT_CLIENT, regardless of via_ep0 or requesting_stream_index.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() grants via_owning_stream to an endpoint's owning stream
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() shall set via_owning_stream true when ep_client is non-NULL, ep_client->has_owning_stream is true, and requesting_stream_index equals ep_client->owning_stream_index.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() withholds via_owning_stream with no owning stream on record
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_writer_ctx() shall set via_owning_stream false when ep_client is NULL or ep_client->has_owning_stream is false.

requirements.title: HW pin-property bit assignments are pairwise distinct
requirements.text: The six RCP_REGMAP_PIN_PROP_* bitmask constants shall each occupy a distinct bit position.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_named_signal_string() never returns NULL
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_named_signal_string() shall return a non-NULL string for every value from 0 through RCP_REGMAP_SIGNAL_COUNT-1, and shall return "unknown" for a value outside that range.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_named_signal_string() returns a unique name per signal
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_named_signal_string() shall return a distinct string for each distinct value from 0 through RCP_REGMAP_SIGNAL_COUNT-1.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_ep_generic_cfg_init() zero-initializes generic endpoint config
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_ep_generic_cfg_init() shall set ep_used to false and every other field of its argument to 0.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes functional endpoint config
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_init() shall set every flag of its argument to false.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_request_stream_cfg_init() zero-initializes request-stream config
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_request_stream_cfg_init() shall set configured to false and every other field of its argument to 0.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_response_queue_cfg_init() zero-initializes response-queue config
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_response_queue_cfg_init() shall set every field of its argument to 0.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() recognizes a strictly ascending table
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() shall return true when every consecutive pair of entries has a strictly increasing byte_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() recognizes a non-ascending table
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() shall return false when any consecutive pair of entries has an equal or decreasing byte_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() is vacuously true for 0 or 1 entries
requirements.text: rcp_regmap_ep_id_map_is_ascending() shall return true when count is 0 or 1.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_should_drop() flags any non-NTSCF subtype
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_should_drop() shall return true for any avtp_subtype value other than the NTSCF subtype, including the TSCF subtype, independent of lifecycle state or time-sync capability.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_encode_request() builds an NTSCF-framed ACF_ABB read at the discovery bus
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_encode_request() shall encode a full NTSCF-framed ACF_ABB message addressed to RCP_SERVER_DISCOVERY_BYTE_BUS_ID with op READ, carrying the given read_size and transaction_num and no payload.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() recovers the requester, read_size, and transaction_num
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall, on RCP_DISCOVERY_OK, populate out_req's requester from the frame's NTSCF stream_id and its read_size/transaction_num from the ACF header.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() drops a TSCF-headed frame
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_NOT_NTSCF when the frame's AVTP subtype is not NTSCF, before attempting any ACF-level parsing.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() rejects a non-ACF_ABB message
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when the NTSCF payload is not an ACF_ABB message.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() rejects the wrong byte_bus_id
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_WRONG_BUS when the ACF header's byte_bus_id is not RCP_SERVER_DISCOVERY_BYTE_BUS_ID.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() rejects a non-read op
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_WRONG_OP when the ACF header's op is not RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_request() rejects a short or empty buffer
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_request() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_SHORT_FRAME when the input buffer is empty or shorter than the frame's declared header-plus-payload length.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_encode_response() payload length always equals the requested read_size
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_encode_response() shall encode a response whose ACF payload length equals read_size exactly, regardless of how many octets of the general register slice are actually defined.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_encode_response() populates the general slice from rcp_regmap_general_t
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_encode_response() shall encode the response's leading RCP_DISCOVERY_GENERAL_SLICE_LEN octets, when present, as big-endian magic, svr_version, vendor_id, device_id, and svr_ep_count taken from map.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_encode_response() zero-fills beyond the general slice
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_encode_response() shall zero-fill any response payload octets beyond RCP_DISCOVERY_GENERAL_SLICE_LEN when read_size exceeds it.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_response() recovers a valid discovery result
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_response() shall, on RCP_DISCOVERY_OK, populate out_result with valid = true, the response frame's own NTSCF stream_id as server_stream_id, and the general slice fields decoded from the payload.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_response() rejects a payload shorter than the general slice
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_response() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_SHORT_FRAME when the ACF payload is shorter than RCP_DISCOVERY_GENERAL_SLICE_LEN octets.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_decode_response() applies the same AVTP/ACF-level checks as a request
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_decode_response() shall return RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_NOT_NTSCF, RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE, RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_WRONG_BUS, or RCP_DISCOVERY_ERR_WRONG_OP under the same conditions rcp_discovery_decode_request() does.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_init() starts unheld with the given timeout
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_init() shall initialize claim with held = false and timeout_ms set to the given value.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_is_open() reports lapsed or never-held claims as open
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_is_open() shall return true when claim has never been held, or when now_ms is at or past claim's deadline_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_note_request() grants an open claim to the requester
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_note_request() shall, when the claim is open, set held = true, claimant = requester, and deadline_ms = now_ms + timeout_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_note_request() does not preempt an active claimant
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_note_request() shall leave an already-held, not-yet-lapsed claim by a different claimant unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_is_claimant() checks held, deadline, and identity
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_is_claimant() shall return true if and only if claim is held, now_ms is strictly before claim's deadline_ms, and claimant equals writer.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_note_config_write() refreshes the deadline for the claimant
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_note_config_write() shall, when writer is the current claimant, set deadline_ms = now_ms + timeout_ms and return true.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_note_config_write() rejects a non-claimant without mutating state
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_note_config_write() shall return false and leave claim unchanged when writer is not the current claimant, including when the claim has already lapsed.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_claim_release() unconditionally clears the claim
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_claim_release() shall set held = false regardless of the claim's prior state.

requirements.title: The discovery result cache stores at most one entry per server_stream_id
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_cache_put() shall overwrite an existing entry whose server_stream_id matches result's in place, and otherwise append a new entry growing internal storage as needed; rcp_discovery_cache_find() shall return a pointer to the matching entry or NULL if none is on record.

requirements.title: rcp_discovery_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_discovery_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_discovery_errc_t value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_gpio_errc_t value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_index_valid() bounds pin indices to 0..31
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_index_valid() shall return true if and only if pin_index is strictly less than RCP_EP_GPIO_MAX_PINS (32).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_mask() derives a single-bit mask, or 0 for an invalid index
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_mask() shall return (1u << pin_index) for a valid pin_index, and 0 for a pin_index that is not rcp_ep_gpio_pin_index_valid().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_get() reads one bit of a bitmask
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_pin_get() shall return true if and only if bitmask's bit at pin_index is set, and shall return false (not an error) for an invalid pin_index.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_write_semantics_valid() accepts exactly 0..7
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_write_semantics_valid() shall return true for every value v with v <= 7, and false for every v > 7.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_REPLACE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_REPLACE shall return request, discarding current.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_OR
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_OR shall return current bitwise-ORed with request.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_AND
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_AND shall return current bitwise-ANDed with request.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_XOR
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_XOR shall return current bitwise-XORed with request.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements saturating RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_ADD
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_ADD shall return current + request when that sum does not exceed 0xFFFFFFFF, and shall return 0xFFFFFFFF (saturating, not wrapping) when it would.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() implements saturating RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_SUB
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_SUB shall return current - request when request <= current, and shall return 0 (saturating, not wrapping) when request > current.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() treats RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_RESERVED6 as a no-op
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_write() with evt = RCP_EP_GPIO_WRITE_RESERVED6 shall return current unchanged, regardless of request.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_reconfig() toggles only the flagged pins' direction
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_apply_reconfig() shall, for every pin index whose bit is set in reconfig_mask, toggle that pin's pin_property between RCP_REGMAP_PIN_PROP_OUTPUT and RCP_REGMAP_PIN_PROP_INPUT while leaving its other pin_property bits unchanged, and shall leave every pin whose bit is clear in reconfig_mask entirely untouched.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() never fires for RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_NONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() with trigger = RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_NONE shall return false for every combination of prev_level and new_level.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_ANY_CHANGE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() with trigger = RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_ANY_CHANGE shall return true if and only if prev_level != new_level.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_RISING
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() with trigger = RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_RISING shall return true if and only if prev_level is false and new_level is true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_FALLING
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_trigger_fires() with trigger = RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_FALLING shall return true if and only if prev_level is true and new_level is false.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_init() shall set cfg's common functional-config flags all false and every pins[i].pin_property to 0 and pins[i].trigger to RCP_EP_GPIO_TRIGGER_NONE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() is unwritable while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false while state is RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED, for every writer context.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() is writable by any writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true while state is RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED, for every writer context.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() shall, while state is RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED, return true if and only if writer.via_root_client_ep0 or writer.via_owning_stream is true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_property() rejects an invalid pin index or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_property() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when pin_index is not rcp_ep_gpio_pin_index_valid(), or when rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() denies the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_property() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_property() shall set cfg->pins[pin_index].pin_property to pin_property and return true when pin_index is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_trigger() rejects an invalid pin index or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_trigger() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when pin_index is not rcp_ep_gpio_pin_index_valid(), or when rcp_ep_gpio_functional_cfg_writable() denies the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_trigger() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_set_pin_trigger() shall set cfg->pins[pin_index].trigger to trigger and return true when pin_index is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: GPIO read request encode/decode round-trips
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_read_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_gpio_encode_read_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_GPIO_OK and recover the original transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_read_request() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: GPIO write request encode/decode round-trips, including evt[2:0]
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_write_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_gpio_encode_write_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_GPIO_OK and recover the original bitmask, evt[2:0] masked to its low three bits, and transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_write_request() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_write_request() shall return RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, and RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_BAD_PAYLOAD_LEN when the payload is not exactly RCP_EP_GPIO_PAYLOAD_LEN octets.

requirements.title: GPIO response encode/decode round-trips when untimed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_gpio_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_GPIO_OK, recover the original bitmask and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp = 0.

requirements.title: GPIO response encode/decode round-trips when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_gpio_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_GPIO_OK, recover the original bitmask and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_response() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_gpio_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header, RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_GPIO_ERR_BAD_PAYLOAD_LEN when the payload is not exactly RCP_EP_GPIO_PAYLOAD_LEN octets.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_spi_errc_t value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() bounds channel indices to 0..5
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() shall return true iff channel < RCP_EP_SPI_MAX_CHANNELS (6).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_mode_valid() accepts exactly 0..3
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_mode_valid() shall return true iff v <= 3.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_mode_cpol() derives CPOL correctly for all 4 modes
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_mode_cpol() shall return false for RCP_EP_SPI_MODE_0/_1 and true for RCP_EP_SPI_MODE_2/_3.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_mode_cpha() derives CPHA correctly for all 4 modes
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_mode_cpha() shall return false for RCP_EP_SPI_MODE_0/_2 and true for RCP_EP_SPI_MODE_1/_3.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() never fires for RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_NONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() shall return false for trigger == RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_NONE regardless of event.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_TRANSFER_DONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_TRANSFER_DONE iff event == RCP_EP_SPI_EVENT_TRANSFER_DONE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_CS_ASSERT
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_CS_ASSERT iff event == RCP_EP_SPI_EVENT_CS_ASSERT.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_CS_DEASSERT
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_CS_DEASSERT iff event == RCP_EP_SPI_EVENT_CS_DEASSERT.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_init() shall set every common flag false and, for every channel, mode = RCP_EP_SPI_MODE_0, bit_order = RCP_EP_SPI_BIT_ORDER_MSB_FIRST, cs_polarity = RCP_EP_SPI_CS_ACTIVE_LOW, trigger = RCP_EP_SPI_TRIGGER_NONE, and clock_divider/inter_byte_delay_ns/inter_transfer_delay_ns all 0.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() is unwritable while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() is writable by any writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer indicates neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_mode() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_mode() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_mode() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_mode() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].mode to the requested mode when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_bit_order() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_bit_order() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_bit_order() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_bit_order() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].bit_order to the requested bit_order when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_cs_polarity() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_cs_polarity() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_cs_polarity() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_cs_polarity() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].cs_polarity to the requested cs_polarity when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_clock_divider() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_clock_divider() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_clock_divider() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_clock_divider() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].clock_divider to the requested value when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_timing() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_timing() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_timing() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_timing() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].inter_byte_delay_ns and inter_transfer_delay_ns to the requested values when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_trigger() rejects an invalid channel or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_trigger() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when channel is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_spi_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_trigger() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_set_channel_trigger() shall return true and set cfg->channels[channel].trigger to the requested trigger when channel is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: SPI transfer request encode/decode round-trips, including channel selection via evt[2:0]
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_decode_transfer_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_spi_encode_transfer_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_SPI_OK and recover the original channel, PICO-out payload bytes, and transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_decode_transfer_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or bad-channel frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_decode_transfer_request() shall return RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, and RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_BAD_CHANNEL when evt[2:0] is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid().

requirements.title: SPI response encode/decode round-trips when untimed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_spi_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_SPI_OK, recover the original channel, POCI-in payload bytes, and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp = 0.

requirements.title: SPI response encode/decode round-trips when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_spi_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_SPI_OK, recover the original channel, POCI-in payload bytes, and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_decode_response() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or bad-channel frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header, RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_SPI_ERR_BAD_CHANNEL when evt[2:0] is not rcp_ep_spi_channel_valid().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_compound_wait_status_equal() compares only the first RCP_EP_SPI_COMPOUND_WAIT_COMPARE_LEN bytes
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_compound_wait_status_equal() shall compare only the first RCP_EP_SPI_COMPOUND_WAIT_COMPARE_LEN (4) bytes of status and target for equality, ignoring any bytes beyond the fourth in either buffer up to RCP_EP_SPI_STATUS_MAX_LEN (20).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_spi_compound_wait_status_equal() returns false when either buffer is shorter than RCP_EP_SPI_COMPOUND_WAIT_COMPARE_LEN
requirements.text: rcp_ep_spi_compound_wait_status_equal() shall return false, never treating a too-short buffer as a match, when status_len or target_len is less than RCP_EP_SPI_COMPOUND_WAIT_COMPARE_LEN (4).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_mode_valid() accepts exactly the four defined presets
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_mode_valid() shall return true for v in 0..3 (RCP_EP_I2C_MODE_STANDARD..RCP_EP_I2C_MODE_HIGH_SPEED) and false for any other value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_init() shall set every rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_t flag in cfg->common to false and cfg->i2c_mode to RCP_EP_I2C_MODE_STANDARD (0), regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() is false while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED, for any writer, by delegating to rcp_server_field_writable() with kind RCP_SERVER_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() is true while HW_CONFIGURED for any writer
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer's contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer has neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream set, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() rejects an invalid mode value
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when mode is not rcp_ep_i2c_mode_valid(), regardless of state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() does not authorize the write for state/writer, even when mode is valid.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() applies a valid, authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_set_mode() shall set cfg->i2c_mode to mode and return true when mode is rcp_ep_i2c_mode_valid() and rcp_ep_i2c_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_strerror() never returns NULL and returns distinct messages
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty message for every rcp_ep_i2c_errc_t value (including an out-of-range value), with a distinct message per defined error code.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_encode_transfer_request() encodes an ACF_ABB write with evt = 0
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_encode_transfer_request() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame with op == RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, evt == 0, byte_bus_id == byte_bus_id, transaction_num == transaction_num, and payload exactly tx_data[0..tx_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_transfer_request() round-trips the raw payload verbatim
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_transfer_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_i2c_encode_transfer_request() and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_I2C_OK and recover the original tx bytes (address byte(s) included, unparsed) and transaction_num unchanged, byte for byte.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_transfer_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or misdirected frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_transfer_request() shall return RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_encode_response() encodes ACF_ABB when untimed and ACF_GBB when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_encode_response() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame when timed is false and an ACF_GBB frame with mtv == RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID and message_timestamp == timestamp when timed is true, in both cases with op == RCP_ACF_OP_READ, evt == 0, and payload exactly rx_data[0..rx_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() round-trips an untimed response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_i2c_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_I2C_OK, recover the original rx payload bytes and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() round-trips a timed response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_i2c_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_I2C_OK, recover the original rx payload bytes and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_i2c_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header and RCP_EP_I2C_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_nr_bits_valid() accepts exactly 1..8
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_nr_bits_valid() shall return true for nr_bits in RCP_EP_UART_NR_BITS_MIN..RCP_EP_UART_NR_BITS_MAX (1..8) inclusive and false for 0 or any value above 8.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_bit_pad_mask() computes (1 << nr_bits) - 1, and 0 for an invalid nr_bits
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_bit_pad_mask() shall return (1u << nr_bits) - 1 for every rcp_ep_uart_nr_bits_valid() nr_bits (0xFF for nr_bits == 8, 0x7F for nr_bits == 7, ...) and 0 for any nr_bits outside 1..8.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_apply_bit_padding() masks every byte in place, and is a no-op for nr_bits == 8
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_apply_bit_padding() shall AND rcp_ep_uart_bit_pad_mask(nr_bits) into every byte of buf[0..len), leaving buf unchanged when nr_bits == 8 and clearing every byte to 0 when nr_bits is outside 1..8.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg except uart_nr_bits
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_init() shall set every rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_t flag in cfg->common to false, baud_rate/ep_rx_buffer_size/uart_timeout_ms to 0, parity to RCP_EP_UART_PARITY_NONE, stop_bits to RCP_EP_UART_STOP_BITS_ONE, and cfg->uart_nr_bits to RCP_EP_UART_NR_BITS_MAX (8), regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() is false while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED, for any writer, by delegating to rcp_server_field_writable() with kind RCP_SERVER_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() is true while HW_CONFIGURED for any writer
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer's contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer has neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream set, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_baud_rate() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_baud_rate() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() does not authorize the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_baud_rate() applies an authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_baud_rate() shall set cfg->baud_rate to baud_rate and return true when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() rejects an invalid nr_bits
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when nr_bits is not rcp_ep_uart_nr_bits_valid(), regardless of state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() does not authorize the write for state/writer, even when nr_bits is valid.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() applies a valid, authorized write to all three fields together
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_frame_format() shall set cfg->uart_nr_bits, cfg->parity, and cfg->stop_bits together and return true when nr_bits is rcp_ep_uart_nr_bits_valid() and rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_rx_buffer_size() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_rx_buffer_size() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() does not authorize the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_rx_buffer_size() applies an authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_rx_buffer_size() shall set cfg->ep_rx_buffer_size to rx_buffer_size and return true when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_timeout() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_timeout() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() does not authorize the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_set_timeout() applies an authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_set_timeout() shall set cfg->uart_timeout_ms to timeout_ms and return true when rcp_ep_uart_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_strerror() never returns NULL and returns distinct messages
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty message for every rcp_ep_uart_errc_t value (including an out-of-range value), with a distinct message per defined error code.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_request() encodes an ACF_ABB write with evt = 0
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_request() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame with op == RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, evt == 0, byte_bus_id == byte_bus_id, transaction_num == transaction_num, and payload exactly tx_data[0..tx_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_request() round-trips the raw TX payload
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_request() and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_UART_OK and recover the original tx bytes and transaction_num unchanged, byte for byte.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or misdirected frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_request() shall return RCP_EP_UART_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_UART_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_UART_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_UART_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_response() encodes ACF_ABB when untimed and ACF_GBB when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_response() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame when timed is false and an ACF_GBB frame with mtv == RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID and message_timestamp == timestamp when timed is true, in both cases with op == RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, evt == 0, and payload exactly accepted_data[0..accepted_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_response() round-trips the accepted-bytes payload and timing
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_write_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_uart_encode_write_response(), the same byte_bus_id, and either timed value, return RCP_EP_UART_OK, recover the accepted payload bytes and transaction_num, and report *out_timed/*out_timestamp consistently with the original timed/timestamp arguments; it shall return RCP_EP_UART_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header and RCP_EP_UART_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_request() carries read_size in the ACF header's read_size_or_segment_num field, with no payload
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_request() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame with op == RCP_ACF_OP_READ, evt == 0, read_size_or_segment_num == read_size, byte_bus_id == byte_bus_id, transaction_num == transaction_num, and an empty payload.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_request() round-trips read_size and transaction_num
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_request() and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_UART_OK and recover the original read_size and transaction_num unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_request() rejects a payload-bearing read request with RCP_EP_UART_ERR_UNKNOWN_CMD
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_UART_ERR_UNKNOWN_CMD, rather than RCP_EP_UART_OK, when an otherwise well-formed read request carries a non-empty payload -- the deliberate asymmetry against GPIO/PWM_OUT request types documented in ep_uart.h.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_response() encodes ACF_ABB when untimed and ACF_GBB when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_response() shall produce an ACF_ABB frame when timed is false and an ACF_GBB frame with mtv == RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID and message_timestamp == timestamp when timed is true, in both cases with op == RCP_ACF_OP_READ, evt == 0, and payload exactly rx_data[0..rx_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_response() round-trips a full-length and a short-read (single-AVTPDU) RX payload
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_uart_encode_read_response() with rx_len equal to or less than the originating request's read_size, return RCP_EP_UART_OK and recover the rx payload bytes, transaction_num, and timed/timestamp state unchanged, with no segment_num-based reassembly performed or required for a same-AVTPDU short read.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_response() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_uart_decode_read_response() shall return RCP_EP_UART_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header and RCP_EP_UART_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_write_semantics_valid() accepts exactly 0..7
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_write_semantics_valid() shall return true for every value v with v <= 7, and false for every v > 7.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_REPLACE per field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_REPLACE, set result.period = request.period and result.active_duration = request.active_duration.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_OR per field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_OR, bitwise-OR request into current independently for the period and active_duration fields.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_AND per field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_AND, bitwise-AND request into current independently for the period and active_duration fields.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_XOR per field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_XOR, bitwise-XOR request into current independently for the period and active_duration fields.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_ADD with per-field 16-bit saturation
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_ADD, add request to current independently for the period and active_duration fields, each saturating at 0xFFFF rather than wrapping or carrying into the other field.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_SUB with per-field 16-bit saturation
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall, for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_SUB, subtract request from current independently for the period and active_duration fields, each saturating at 0x0000 rather than wrapping.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() treats RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_RESERVED6 as a no-op
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall return current unchanged for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_RESERVED6.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() fails safe for a misrouted RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_RECONFIG
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_write() shall return current unchanged for evt == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_WRITE_RECONFIG, since callers must route that value to rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_reconfig() instead.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_reconfig() toggles *enabled when bit 0 of reconfig_word is set
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_reconfig() shall toggle *enabled iff bit 0 of reconfig_word is set, regardless of the state of any other bit.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_reconfig() leaves *enabled unchanged when bit 0 of reconfig_word is clear
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_apply_reconfig() shall leave *enabled unchanged when bit 0 of reconfig_word is clear, regardless of the state of any other bit.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() never fires for RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_NONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() shall return false for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_NONE regardless of event.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_CYCLE_START
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_CYCLE_START iff event == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_EVENT_CYCLE_START.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_MID_PULSE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_MID_PULSE iff event == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_EVENT_MID_PULSE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_DONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_DONE iff event == RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_EVENT_DONE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_init() shall set every common flag false, trigger = RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_TRIGGER_NONE, and enabled = false, regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() is unwritable while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() is writable by any writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer indicates neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_trigger() rejects an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_trigger() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_trigger() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_trigger() shall return true and set cfg->trigger to the requested trigger when the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_enabled() rejects an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_enabled() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_pwm_out_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_enabled() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_set_enabled() shall return true and set cfg->enabled to the requested value when the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_pwm_out_errc_t value, including an out-of-range value.

requirements.title: PWM_OUT read request encode/decode round-trips
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_read_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_out_encode_read_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_OK and recover the original transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_read_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or wrong-op frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header, RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: PWM_OUT write request encode/decode round-trips, including evt[2:0] write semantics
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_write_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_out_encode_write_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_OK and recover the original value, evt[2:0], and transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_write_request() rejects a malformed, wrong-op, or bad-payload-length frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_write_request() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, and RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_BAD_PAYLOAD_LEN when the payload is not exactly RCP_EP_PWM_PAYLOAD_LEN octets.

requirements.title: PWM_OUT response encode/decode round-trips when untimed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_out_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp = 0.

requirements.title: PWM_OUT response encode/decode round-trips when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_out_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_response() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_out_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header and RCP_EP_PWM_OUT_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() never fires for RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_NONE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() shall return false for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_NONE regardless of the level transition.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_RISING
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_RISING iff prev_level is false and new_level is true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_FALLING
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_trigger_fires() shall return true for trigger == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_FALLING iff prev_level is true and new_level is false.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_init() shall set every common flag false and trigger = RCP_EP_PWM_IN_TRIGGER_NONE, regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() is unwritable while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() is writable by any writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer indicates neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_set_trigger() rejects an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_set_trigger() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_pwm_in_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_set_trigger() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_set_trigger() shall return true and set cfg->trigger to the requested trigger when the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_pwm_in_errc_t value.

requirements.title: PWM_IN read request encode/decode round-trips
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_read_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_in_encode_read_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_OK and recover the original transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_read_request() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header and RCP_EP_PWM_IN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: PWM_IN response encode/decode round-trips when untimed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_in_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp = 0.

requirements.title: PWM_IN response encode/decode round-trips when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_in_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_response() rejects a misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: PWM_IN response encode/decode round-trips RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL verbatim
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_pwm_in_encode_response() with either or both of value's fields equal to RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL, recover that sentinel unchanged, treating it as an ordinary uint16_t value with no special decode-time handling.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_mode_valid() accepts exactly 4..7
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_mode_valid() shall return true for every value v with 4 <= v <= 7, and false for every other value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_PERIOD_GE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall, for mode == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_PERIOD_GE, return true iff captured.period is not RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL and captured.period >= threshold.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_PERIOD_LE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall, for mode == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_PERIOD_LE, return true iff captured.period is not RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL and captured.period <= threshold.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_DUTY_GE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall, for mode == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_DUTY_GE, return true iff captured.active_duration is not RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL and captured.active_duration >= threshold.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() implements RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_DUTY_LE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall, for mode == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_DUTY_LE, return true iff captured.active_duration is not RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL and captured.active_duration <= threshold.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() returns false for an invalid mode
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall return false, never treating it as a match, for any mode value outside RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_PERIOD_GE..RCP_EP_PWM_IN_CMP_DUTY_LE (4..7).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() never matches a RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL sub-field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_pwm_in_compound_wait_compare() shall return false for every defined mode whenever the sub-field that mode compares (captured.period for PERIOD_GE/PERIOD_LE, captured.active_duration for DUTY_GE/DUTY_LE) equals RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL, regardless of threshold.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_mode_valid() accepts exactly the four defined combine modes
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_mode_valid() shall return true for v in 0..3 (RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_AVERAGE..RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_LATEST) and false for any other value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() computes the arithmetic mean of its raw samples
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() shall, given sample_count samples none of which equal RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL, return a value equal to their arithmetic mean, rounded down.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() returns RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL with a zero timestamp when sample_count is 0
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() shall return value == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL and timestamp == 0 when sample_count == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() excludes RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL samples from its mean, and reports NO_SIGNAL only if every sample timed out
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() shall exclude every sample whose value equals RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL from its arithmetic mean, and shall return value == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL only when every sample in the interval equals RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() reports the interval's first sample's timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_average_interval() shall set the returned timestamp to samples[0].timestamp for any sample_count > 0, regardless of how many samples are averaged or excluded.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() implements RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_AVERAGE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall, for combine_mode == RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_AVERAGE, return the arithmetic mean (rounded down) of every avg_values[i].value not equal to RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() implements RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MIN
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall, for combine_mode == RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MIN, return the smallest avg_values[i].value not equal to RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() implements RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MAX
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall, for combine_mode == RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MAX, return the largest avg_values[i].value not equal to RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() implements RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_LATEST, including verbatim NO_SIGNAL reporting
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall, for combine_mode == RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_LATEST, return avg_values[avg_count - 1].value unchanged, even when that value equals RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() returns RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL when avg_count is 0
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL when avg_count == 0, for every combine_mode.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() returns RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL when every avg_value is itself NO_SIGNAL, for AVERAGE/MIN/MAX
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_combine_avg_values() shall return RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL when every avg_values[i].value equals RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL, for combine_mode in RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_AVERAGE, RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MIN, and RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_MAX.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_capture_moment_timestamp() returns the first avg_value's timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_capture_moment_timestamp() shall return avg_values[0].timestamp for any avg_count > 0, independent of combine_mode.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_capture_moment_timestamp() returns 0 when avg_count is 0
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_capture_moment_timestamp() shall return 0 when avg_count == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_init() shall set every common flag false, adc_samples_per_avg_interval = 0, adc_avg_intervals_per_request = 0, and adc_combine_avg_values = RCP_EP_ADC_COMBINE_AVERAGE (0), regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() is unwritable while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() is writable by any writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization once RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for state == RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer indicates neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_samples_per_avg_interval() rejects an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_samples_per_avg_interval() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_samples_per_avg_interval() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_samples_per_avg_interval() shall return true and set cfg->adc_samples_per_avg_interval to the requested value when the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_avg_intervals_per_request() rejects an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_avg_intervals_per_request() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_avg_intervals_per_request() applies the write when authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_avg_intervals_per_request() shall return true and set cfg->adc_avg_intervals_per_request to the requested value when the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_combine_mode() rejects an invalid mode or an unauthorized write without mutating cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_combine_mode() shall return false and leave cfg unchanged when combine_mode is not rcp_ep_adc_combine_mode_valid() or the write is not authorized by rcp_ep_adc_functional_cfg_writable().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_set_combine_mode() applies the write when valid and authorized
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_set_combine_mode() shall return true and set cfg->adc_combine_avg_values to the requested combine_mode when combine_mode is valid and the write is authorized.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_adc_errc_t value, including an out-of-range value.

requirements.title: ADC read request encode/decode round-trips
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_read_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_adc_encode_read_request() with the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_ADC_OK and recover the original transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_decode_read_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or wrong-op frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_ADC_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB fixed header, RCP_EP_ADC_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_ADC_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: ADC response encode/decode round-trips when untimed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_adc_encode_response() with timed = false and the same byte_bus_id, return RCP_EP_ADC_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = false with *out_timestamp = 0.

requirements.title: ADC response encode/decode round-trips when timed
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_adc_encode_response() with timed = true, the same byte_bus_id, and a timestamp, return RCP_EP_ADC_OK, recover the original value and transaction_num, and report *out_timed = true with *out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_adc_decode_response() rejects a bad-payload-length frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_ADC_ERR_BAD_PAYLOAD_LEN when the decoded payload is not exactly RCP_EP_ADC_PAYLOAD_LEN octets.

requirements.title: ADC response encode/decode round-trips RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL verbatim
requirements.text: rcp_ep_adc_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_adc_encode_response() with value == RCP_EP_PWM_IN_NO_SIGNAL, recover that sentinel unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_new() treats count == 0 as unsupported, not a failure
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_new() shall, given count == 0, return a table with state == NULL and count == 0, and rcp_sequencer_table_unsupported() shall report true for that table.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_new() reports allocation failure via a zeroed table
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_new() shall, given a nonzero count for which the underlying allocation fails, return a table with state == NULL and count == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_new() initializes every register to the power-on default
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_new() shall, given a nonzero count for which allocation succeeds, return a table with count registers, each initialized to RCP_SEQUENCER_POWER_ON_STATE (1).

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_unsupported() is true iff count == 0
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_unsupported() shall return true iff table->count == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_reset() restores every register to the power-on default
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_reset() shall set every sequencer in a nonzero-count table back to RCP_SEQUENCER_POWER_ON_STATE, and shall be a no-op on a count == 0 table.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_table_free() zeroes the table and is idempotent
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_table_free() shall free table->state (if any) and set table->state = NULL and table->count = 0, and shall be safe to call again on an already-zeroed table.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_index_valid() bounds idx to 0..count-1
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_index_valid() shall return true iff idx < table->count.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_get_state() reads the current state of a valid index
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_get_state() shall, given a valid idx, return true and set *out_state to table->state[idx].

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_get_state() rejects an invalid index without touching *out_state
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_get_state() shall, given an idx for which rcp_sequencer_index_valid() is false, return false and leave *out_state unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_set_state() overwrites the state of a valid index
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_set_state() shall, given a valid idx, set table->state[idx] to state and return true.

requirements.title: rcp_sequencer_set_state() rejects an invalid index without changing table
requirements.text: rcp_sequencer_set_state() shall, given an idx for which rcp_sequencer_index_valid() is false, return false and leave table entirely unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_request_type_is_safety() reports the MSB (0x80) of request_type
requirements.text: rcp_request_type_is_safety() shall return true iff (request_type & 0x80) != 0.

requirements.title: rcp_request_type_is_compound() recognizes RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND and its safety variant
requirements.text: rcp_request_type_is_compound() shall return true iff request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND or request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_SAFETY.

requirements.title: rcp_request_type_is_compound_wait() recognizes RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_WAIT and its safety variant
