requirements.text: rcp_request_type_is_compound_wait() shall return true iff request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_WAIT or request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_WAIT_SAFETY.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_strerror() never returns NULL and is unique per code
requirements.text: rcp_compound_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_compound_errc_t value, and a non-NULL message for any other value.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() rejects a frame shorter than the ACF_GBB header
requirements.text: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_SHORT_FRAME when len < RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() rejects a non-ACF_GBB message
requirements.text: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when b[0] != RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() reads the repurposed opcode byte when mtv is untimed
requirements.text: rcp_compound_peek_request_type() shall, given a well-formed ACF_GBB frame whose decoded mtv nibble equals RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, return RCP_COMPOUND_OK and set *out_request_type to b[RCP_ACF_ABB_HEADER_LEN]; and shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when that mtv nibble is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_encode_request() rejects an unrecognized request_type
requirements.text: rcp_compound_encode_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when request_type is neither rcp_request_type_is_compound() nor rcp_request_type_is_compound_wait().

requirements.title: rcp_compound_encode_request() rejects an oversized payload
requirements.text: rcp_compound_encode_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when payload_len exceeds RCP_ACF_MAX_PAYLOAD.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_encode_request() encodes an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced untimed and the opcode/step packed into message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_compound_encode_request() shall, given a recognized request_type and payload_len <= RCP_ACF_MAX_PAYLOAD, produce an RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN + payload_len byte frame of type RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB addressed to byte_bus_id, whose decoded mtv nibble is RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED and whose message_timestamp region's leading byte equals request_type with the remaining 7 bytes packing step's sequencer_index/start_state/next_state/exec_delay_ms/repeat_count fields, followed by payload.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_request() rejects a frame shorter than declared
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_request() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_SHORT_FRAME when b is shorter than the ACF_GBB fixed header or its declared payload length.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_request() rejects a non-ACF_GBB message
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_request() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when b[0] != RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_request() rejects a message whose mtv is not untimed
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_request() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded byte_message_info.mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_request() rejects a request_type it does not recognize
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_request() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is neither rcp_request_type_is_compound() nor rcp_request_type_is_compound_wait().

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_request() round-trips a frame produced by rcp_compound_encode_request()
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_compound_encode_request(), return RCP_COMPOUND_OK and recover the original request_type, byte_bus_id, step (sequencer_index/start_state/next_state/exec_delay_ms/repeat_count), transaction_num, and a borrowed view of the original payload.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_encode_clear_non_safestate() encodes an RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN-byte, opcode-0x06, mtv-untimed frame
requirements.text: rcp_compound_encode_clear_non_safestate() shall produce an RCP_ACF_GBB_HEADER_LEN-byte frame of type RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB addressed to byte_bus_id, echoing transaction_num, with mtv RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED and the message_timestamp region's leading byte equal to RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_NON_SAFESTATE and its remaining 7 bytes zero.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_clear_non_safestate() round-trips a frame produced by its own encoder
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_clear_non_safestate() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_compound_encode_clear_non_safestate(), return RCP_COMPOUND_OK and recover the original byte_bus_id and transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_decode_clear_non_safestate() rejects a request_type other than 0x06
requirements.text: rcp_compound_decode_clear_non_safestate() shall return RCP_COMPOUND_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_NON_SAFESTATE, given the same short-frame/bad-msg-type/not-repurposed failure modes as rcp_compound_decode_request().

requirements.title: rcp_compound_advance_guard() is true iff the target sequencer is still in start_state
requirements.text: rcp_compound_advance_guard() shall return true iff step->sequencer_index is rcp_sequencer_index_valid() for table and table's current state at that index equals step->start_state, and shall return false (never a fabricated true) for an invalid sequencer_index.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_exec_delay_elapsed() compares elapsed_ms against exec_delay_ms
requirements.text: rcp_compound_exec_delay_elapsed() shall return true iff elapsed_ms >= step->exec_delay_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_tick() advances the sequencer only once both the delay has elapsed and the guard holds
requirements.text: rcp_compound_tick() shall set table's sequencer step->sequencer_index to step->next_state and return true iff both rcp_compound_exec_delay_elapsed(step, elapsed_ms) and rcp_compound_advance_guard(table, step) are true; otherwise it shall leave table unchanged and return false.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_tick() never advances a sequencer that has already left start_state, even after its delay elapses
requirements.text: rcp_compound_tick() shall return false and leave table unchanged when elapsed_ms >= step->exec_delay_ms but the target sequencer's current state does not equal step->start_state.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_wait_tick() advances the sequencer only once both condition_met and the guard hold
requirements.text: rcp_compound_wait_tick() shall set table's sequencer step->sequencer_index to step->next_state and return true iff both condition_met and rcp_compound_advance_guard(table, step) are true; otherwise it shall leave table unchanged and return false, regardless of any elapsed-time value.

requirements.title: rcp_compound_wait_tick() never advances a sequencer that has already left start_state, even on a condition match
requirements.text: rcp_compound_wait_tick() shall return false and leave table unchanged when condition_met is true but the target sequencer's current state does not equal step->start_state.

requirements.title: rcp_request_type_is_triggered() recognizes RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED and its safety variant
requirements.text: rcp_request_type_is_triggered() shall return true iff request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED or request_type == RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED_SAFETY.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_strerror() never returns NULL and gives every error code a distinct message
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_strerror() shall return a non-NULL string for every rcp_triggered_errc_t value, including unrecognized ones, with each defined error code mapped to a distinct message.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_encode_request() rejects a request_type it does not recognize
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_encode_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when request_type is neither RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED nor RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED_SAFETY.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_encode_request() packs step into the repurposed message_timestamp region
requirements.text: For a recognized request_type, rcp_triggered_encode_request() shall produce an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced to RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, the opcode byte set to request_type, and step's sequencer_index/start_state/next_state/trigger_exec_delay_ms/repeat_count packed into the remaining 7 sub-field bytes.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_decode_request() maps ACF decode failures to their rcp_triggered_errc_t equivalents
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_decode_request() shall return RCP_TRIGGERED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME or RCP_TRIGGERED_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when rcp_acf_decode_gbb() reports the corresponding failure.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_decode_request() rejects a non-repurposed message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_decode_request() shall return RCP_TRIGGERED_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_decode_request() rejects an opcode byte that is not a triggered request_type
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_decode_request() shall return RCP_TRIGGERED_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte does not satisfy rcp_request_type_is_triggered(), and shall otherwise populate *out_request_type, *out_byte_bus_id, *out_step, *out_transaction_num, and a borrowed *out_payload/*out_payload_len view into the input buffer.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_runtime_enter_started() resets the trigger-occurrence counter
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_runtime_enter_started() shall set occurrence_count to 0 and started to true.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_runtime_record_occurrence() only increments the counter once started
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_runtime_record_occurrence() shall increment occurrence_count and return true iff started is true, and shall leave occurrence_count unchanged and return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_advance_guard() reports whether the target sequencer is still in start_state
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_advance_guard() shall return true iff step->sequencer_index is a valid index into table and that sequencer's current state equals step->start_state, and shall return false for an invalid sequencer_index.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_exec_delay_elapsed() compares elapsed_ms against trigger_exec_delay_ms
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_exec_delay_elapsed() shall return true iff elapsed_ms >= step->trigger_exec_delay_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_tick() only fires when started, at least one occurrence is recorded, the delay has elapsed, and the endpoint is idle
requirements.text: rcp_triggered_tick() shall return false and leave table and rt unchanged unless rt->started is true, rt->occurrence_count > 0, rcp_triggered_exec_delay_elapsed() holds, and endpoint_idle is true.

requirements.title: rcp_triggered_tick() advances the sequencer and resets the runtime on a successful fire
requirements.text: When rcp_triggered_tick()'s firing conditions all hold and rcp_triggered_advance_guard() holds, it shall set table's target sequencer to step->next_state, reset rt->occurrence_count to 0 and rt->started to false, and return true.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_strerror() never returns NULL and gives every error code a distinct message
requirements.text: rcp_chained_strerror() shall return a non-NULL string for every rcp_chained_errc_t value, including unrecognized ones, with each defined error code mapped to a distinct message.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_encode_member() rejects chain_length below RCP_CHAINED_MIN_MEMBERS
requirements.text: rcp_chained_encode_member() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when chain_length < RCP_CHAINED_MIN_MEMBERS.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_encode_member() rejects chain_position >= chain_length
requirements.text: rcp_chained_encode_member() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when chain_position >= chain_length.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_encode_member() packs chain_length/chain_position and cs into the encoded frame
requirements.text: For valid inputs, rcp_chained_encode_member() shall produce an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced to RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, the opcode byte set to RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CHAINED, cs encoded into byte_message_info's cs field, and chain_length/chain_position packed into the repurposed message_timestamp region's sub-field bytes.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_decode_member() maps ACF decode failures to their rcp_chained_errc_t equivalents
requirements.text: rcp_chained_decode_member() shall return RCP_CHAINED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME or RCP_CHAINED_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when rcp_acf_decode_gbb() reports the corresponding failure.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_decode_member() rejects a non-repurposed message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_chained_decode_member() shall return RCP_CHAINED_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_decode_member() rejects an opcode byte that is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CHAINED
requirements.text: rcp_chained_decode_member() shall return RCP_CHAINED_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CHAINED, and shall otherwise populate *out_byte_bus_id, *out_chain_length, *out_chain_position, *out_cs, *out_transaction_num, and a borrowed *out_payload/*out_payload_len view into the input buffer.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_advance() reports RCP_CHAINED_MEMBER_CHAIN_ABORTED once *chain_aborted is set, without consulting member_errored/cs
requirements.text: rcp_chained_advance() shall return RCP_CHAINED_MEMBER_CHAIN_ABORTED and leave *chain_aborted unchanged whenever *chain_aborted is already true on entry.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_advance() reports RCP_CHAINED_MEMBER_OK for a non-errored member
requirements.text: rcp_chained_advance() shall return RCP_CHAINED_MEMBER_OK and leave *chain_aborted false whenever *chain_aborted is false on entry and member_errored is false.

requirements.title: rcp_chained_advance() sets *chain_aborted only when an errored member selected RCP_CHAINED_CS_ABORT_ON_ERROR
requirements.text: rcp_chained_advance() shall return RCP_CHAINED_MEMBER_CHAIN_ERROR whenever *chain_aborted is false on entry and member_errored is true, and shall set *chain_aborted to true iff cs == RCP_CHAINED_CS_ABORT_ON_ERROR (leaving it false when cs == RCP_CHAINED_CS_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR).

requirements.title: rcp_timed_strerror() never returns NULL and gives every error code a distinct message
requirements.text: rcp_timed_strerror() shall return a non-NULL string for every rcp_timed_errc_t value, including unrecognized ones, with each defined error code mapped to a distinct message.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_feature_enabled() requires both time-sync option bits set
requirements.text: rcp_timed_feature_enabled() shall return true iff both RCP_REGMAP_OPT_TIME_SYNC_TSCF and RCP_REGMAP_OPT_TIME_SYNC_PRESENTATION are set in options.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_encode_request() packs presentation_time into the repurposed message_timestamp region
requirements.text: rcp_timed_encode_request() shall produce an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced to RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, the opcode byte set to RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TIMED, and presentation_time packed into the repurposed message_timestamp region's first 4 sub-field bytes, or return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data == NULL) when payload_len exceeds RCP_ACF_MAX_PAYLOAD.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_decode_request() maps ACF decode failures and rejects a non-repurposed message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_timed_decode_request() shall return RCP_TIMED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME or RCP_TIMED_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when rcp_acf_decode_gbb() reports the corresponding failure, and RCP_TIMED_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_decode_request() rejects an opcode byte that is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TIMED
requirements.text: rcp_timed_decode_request() shall return RCP_TIMED_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TIMED, and shall otherwise populate *out_byte_bus_id, *out_presentation_time, *out_transaction_num, and a borrowed *out_payload/*out_payload_len view into the input buffer.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_too_far() is wraparound-safe and never reports a past presentation_time as too far
requirements.text: rcp_timed_too_far() shall return false whenever presentation_time is at or before now (by wraparound-safe signed subtraction), and shall return true iff presentation_time is strictly after now by more than max_horizon.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_admit() reports RCP_TIMED_REJECT_GPTP_FAIL whenever gptp_locked is false
requirements.text: rcp_timed_admit() shall return RCP_TIMED_REJECT_GPTP_FAIL whenever gptp_locked is false, regardless of presentation_time, now, or max_horizon.

requirements.title: rcp_timed_admit() reports RCP_TIMED_REJECT_PRESENTATION_TIME_TOO_FAR or RCP_TIMED_ACCEPT when gPTP is locked
requirements.text: rcp_timed_admit() shall return RCP_TIMED_REJECT_PRESENTATION_TIME_TOO_FAR when gptp_locked is true and rcp_timed_too_far(presentation_time, now, max_horizon) holds, and RCP_TIMED_ACCEPT otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_strerror() never returns NULL and gives every error code a distinct message
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_strerror() shall return a non-NULL string for every rcp_cancel_errc_t value, including unrecognized ones, with each defined error code mapped to a distinct message.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_encode_clear_all() encodes a zero-payload clear-all request
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_encode_clear_all() shall produce an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced to RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, the opcode byte set to RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_ALL, and the remaining repurposed sub-field bytes zeroed.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_all() maps ACF decode failures and rejects a non-repurposed message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_all() shall return RCP_CANCEL_ERR_SHORT_FRAME or RCP_CANCEL_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when rcp_acf_decode_gbb() reports the corresponding failure, and RCP_CANCEL_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_all() rejects an opcode byte that is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_ALL
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_all() shall return RCP_CANCEL_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_ALL, and shall otherwise populate *out_byte_bus_id and *out_transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_encode_clear_single() packs clear_transaction_num into the repurposed message_timestamp region
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_encode_clear_single() shall produce an ACF_GBB frame with mtv forced to RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED, the opcode byte set to RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_SINGLE, clear_transaction_num packed into the first repurposed sub-field byte, and the remaining sub-field bytes zeroed.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_single() maps ACF decode failures and rejects a non-repurposed message_timestamp
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_single() shall return RCP_CANCEL_ERR_SHORT_FRAME or RCP_CANCEL_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when rcp_acf_decode_gbb() reports the corresponding failure, and RCP_CANCEL_ERR_NOT_REPURPOSED when the decoded mtv is not RCP_ACF_MTV_UNTIMED.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_single() rejects an opcode byte that is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_SINGLE
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_decode_clear_single() shall return RCP_CANCEL_ERR_UNKNOWN_TYPE when the decoded opcode byte is not RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_CLEAR_SINGLE, and shall otherwise populate *out_byte_bus_id, *out_clear_transaction_num, and *out_transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_is_cancellable() is true only for RCP_CANCEL_LIFECYCLE_QUEUED
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_is_cancellable() shall return true iff state == RCP_CANCEL_LIFECYCLE_QUEUED, and false for RCP_CANCEL_LIFECYCLE_EXECUTING or RCP_CANCEL_LIFECYCLE_DONE.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_attempt() reports RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the target was not found
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_attempt() shall return RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_NOT_FOUND whenever found is false, regardless of state.

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_attempt() reports RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_NOT_CANCELLABLE for a found request outside the cancellable window
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_attempt() shall return RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_NOT_CANCELLABLE whenever found is true and !rcp_cancel_is_cancellable(state).

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_attempt() reports RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_CANCELED for a found, cancellable request
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_attempt() shall return RCP_CANCEL_RESULT_CANCELED whenever found is true and rcp_cancel_is_cancellable(state).

requirements.title: rcp_cancel_chain_should_cascade() cascades to a chain member's own position and every position after it
requirements.text: rcp_cancel_chain_should_cascade() shall return true iff member_position >= canceled_position.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_classify() classifies every repurposed opcode this project's request-kind modules define
requirements.text: rcp_sched_classify() shall return RCP_SCHED_KIND_STANDARD whenever is_repurposed is false, and shall otherwise classify request_type into RCP_SCHED_KIND_CANCELLATION (clear-all/clear-non-safestate/clear-single), RCP_SCHED_KIND_TRIGGERED, RCP_SCHED_KIND_TIMED, RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND, RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND_WAIT, RCP_SCHED_KIND_CHAINED, or RCP_SCHED_KIND_STANDARD for any opcode not recognized by those modules.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_kind_rank() encodes the cancellation > triggered > timed > compound > compound-wait > chained > standard ordering
requirements.text: rcp_sched_kind_rank() shall return a strictly higher value for RCP_SCHED_KIND_CANCELLATION than RCP_SCHED_KIND_TRIGGERED, for RCP_SCHED_KIND_TRIGGERED than RCP_SCHED_KIND_TIMED, for RCP_SCHED_KIND_TIMED than RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND, for RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND than RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND_WAIT, for RCP_SCHED_KIND_COMPOUND_WAIT than RCP_SCHED_KIND_CHAINED, and for RCP_SCHED_KIND_CHAINED than RCP_SCHED_KIND_STANDARD.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_compare() orders by rank first and FIFO sequence second
requirements.text: rcp_sched_compare() shall return a negative value when a's rank exceeds b's rank (regardless of sequence), a positive value when b's rank exceeds a's, and among equal ranks shall return negative iff a->sequence < b->sequence, positive iff a->sequence > b->sequence, and zero only when both kind and sequence are equal.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_split_frame_members() reports every member's byte offset in an ACF payload stream
requirements.text: For a well-formed ACF payload stream (every member's declared acf_msg_type/acf_msg_length correctly delimiting a header-plus-payload region that fits within the stream), rcp_sched_split_frame_members() shall return the number of members found and write each member's starting byte offset, in order, into out_offsets (up to out_cap entries).

requirements.title: rcp_sched_split_frame_members() returns 0 on a malformed stream
requirements.text: rcp_sched_split_frame_members() shall return 0 when the first byte is neither RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_ABB nor RCP_ACF_MSG_TYPE_GBB, or when any member's own declared header-plus-payload length would run past len, without writing a partial member to out_offsets.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_split_frame_members() returns 0 for an empty stream
requirements.text: rcp_sched_split_frame_members() shall return 0 when len == 0.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_frame_timing_consistent() is trivially true for NTSCF frames and empty member lists
requirements.text: rcp_sched_frame_timing_consistent() shall return true whenever is_tscf is false, and shall return true whenever count == 0, regardless of member_is_timed's contents.

requirements.title: rcp_sched_frame_timing_consistent() rejects a TSCF frame mixing timed and untimed members
requirements.text: For is_tscf == true and count > 0, rcp_sched_frame_timing_consistent() shall return true iff every entry in member_is_timed[0..count) equals member_is_timed[0], and false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_strerror() never returns NULL and gives every error code a distinct message
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_strerror() shall return a non-NULL string for every rcp_e2e_errc_t value, including unrecognized ones, with each defined error code mapped to a distinct message.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_crc32() implements the fixed CRC32 parameter set (poly 0xF4ACFB13, init/xorout 0xFFFFFFFF, refin/refout true)
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_crc32() shall compute a 32-bit CRC using polynomial 0xF4ACFB13, initial value 0xFFFFFFFF, final XOR 0xFFFFFFFF, with both input and output reflection enabled, verified against the published CRC-32/AUTOSAR check value 0x1697D06A over the ASCII bytes "123456789".

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_compute_crc() covers stream_id, avtp_timestamp, and the ACF header-and-payload region, in that order
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_compute_crc() shall return the same value as calling rcp_e2e_crc32() over the concatenation of stream_id (8 bytes, big-endian), avtp_timestamp (8 bytes, big-endian), and acf_frame[0..acf_frame_len).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_length_with_crc() applies the length-accounting pre-adjustment
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_length_with_crc() shall return payload_len + RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN, saturating at SIZE_MAX rather than wrapping when payload_len is within RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN of SIZE_MAX.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wrap() appends a big-endian CRC32 trailer computed via rcp_e2e_compute_crc()
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wrap() shall return an owned rcp_bytes_t equal to acf_frame[0..acf_frame_len) followed by RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN big-endian bytes holding rcp_e2e_compute_crc(stream_id, avtp_timestamp, acf_frame, acf_frame_len).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wrap() fails safe on invalid input or allocation failure
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wrap() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t (data=NULL, len=0) when acf_frame is NULL while acf_frame_len != 0, or when the internal allocation fails.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_unwrap() rejects a frame shorter than the CRC32 trailer
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_unwrap() shall return RCP_E2E_ERR_SHORT_FRAME whenever frame_len < RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_unwrap() reports CRC_ERROR on a mismatched trailer
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_unwrap() shall return RCP_E2E_ERR_CRC_MISMATCH whenever the trailing RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN bytes of frame do not equal rcp_e2e_compute_crc(stream_id, avtp_timestamp, frame, frame_len - RCP_E2E_CRC_LEN); a caller receiving this code shall skip executing the request the frame carries.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_unwrap() round-trips a frame produced by rcp_e2e_wrap()
requirements.text: For a frame produced by rcp_e2e_wrap(stream_id, avtp_timestamp, acf_frame, acf_frame_len), rcp_e2e_unwrap() called with the same stream_id and avtp_timestamp shall return RCP_E2E_OK with *out_acf_frame/*out_acf_frame_len describing exactly acf_frame[0..acf_frame_len).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_fragment_carries_crc() implements the fragmentation/CRC interaction rule
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_fragment_carries_crc() shall return is_last_fragment unmodified, modeling that only a multi-segment message's final fragment carries a CRC.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_is_safety_request() tests request_type's MSB
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_is_safety_request() shall return true iff (request_type & 0x80) != 0, covering RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_SAFETY (0x8F), RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_COMPOUND_WAIT_SAFETY (0x8B), and RCP_REQUEST_TYPE_TRIGGERED_SAFETY (0x8E).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_request_may_execute() gates safety-tagged requests on the endpoint's safe-state flag
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_request_may_execute() shall return endpoint_in_safe_state whenever rcp_e2e_is_safety_request(request_type) is true.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_request_may_execute() always permits a non-safety-tagged request_type
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_request_may_execute() shall return true whenever rcp_e2e_is_safety_request(request_type) is false, regardless of endpoint_in_safe_state.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_watchdog_purge_should_keep() implements the watchdog-purge-vs-safety-survive rule
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_watchdog_purge_should_keep() shall return rcp_e2e_is_safety_request(request_type).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_watchdog_purge_classify() applies the purge rule across a caller-supplied array
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_watchdog_purge_classify() shall write rcp_e2e_watchdog_purge_should_keep(request_types[i]) into out_keep[i] for every i in [0, count).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_measure_valid() recognizes exactly the two defined rcp_e2e_measure_t values
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_measure_valid() shall return true iff rx_safety_measure equals RCP_E2E_MEASURE_FORCE_HIGH_IMPEDANCE or RCP_E2E_MEASURE_SEQUENCER, and false for any other byte value.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() always reports true for the force-high-impedance measure
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() shall return true whenever rx_safety_measure == RCP_E2E_MEASURE_FORCE_HIGH_IMPEDANCE, regardless of table, safestate_sequencer, or safe_sequencer_state.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() polls the configured sequencer for the sequencer-based measure
requirements.text: For rx_safety_measure == RCP_E2E_MEASURE_SEQUENCER and a valid safestate_sequencer index into a non-NULL table, rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() shall return true iff rcp_sequencer_get_state(table, safestate_sequencer, ...) reports a state equal to safe_sequencer_state.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() fails closed on an unrecognized measure or an invalid sequencer index
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_endpoint_in_safe_state() shall return false when rx_safety_measure is not a value recognized by rcp_e2e_measure_valid(), when table is NULL for RCP_E2E_MEASURE_SEQUENCER, or when safestate_sequencer does not address a valid entry in table.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_crc_error_action() maps rx_enforce_e2e to the correct CRC-error action
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_crc_error_action() shall return RCP_E2E_CRC_ACTION_LATCH_STREAM_FAULT iff rx_enforce_e2e is true, and RCP_E2E_CRC_ACTION_DROP_REQUEST otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_on_crc_error() always signals skip-this-request and latches under rx_enforce_e2e
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_on_crc_error() shall always return true, and shall additionally set f->faulted to true whenever rcp_e2e_crc_error_action(rx_enforce_e2e) == RCP_E2E_CRC_ACTION_LATCH_STREAM_FAULT.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_on_crc_error() leaves f unchanged for the drop-request action
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_on_crc_error() shall leave f->faulted unmodified whenever rcp_e2e_crc_error_action(rx_enforce_e2e) == RCP_E2E_CRC_ACTION_DROP_REQUEST.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_reset() clears a latched fault
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_stream_fault_reset() shall set f->faulted to false, and rcp_e2e_stream_fault_is_faulted() shall report false immediately afterward.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() never reports an overflow while the per-stream watchdog is disabled
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() shall set overflowed to false whenever rx_wd_enable is false, regardless of elapsed_since_last_kick_ms or rx_wd_timeout_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() reports an overflow once the elapsed time reaches the configured timeout
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() shall set overflowed to true iff rx_wd_enable is true and elapsed_since_last_kick_ms >= rx_wd_timeout_ms.

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() gates enter_safe_state on rx_wd_safestate_enable
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() shall set enter_safe_state to (overflowed && rx_wd_safestate_enable).

requirements.title: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() gates notify on rx_wd_info_enable independently of enter_safe_state
requirements.text: rcp_e2e_wd_evaluate() shall set notify to (overflowed && rx_wd_info_enable), independent of the value computed for enter_safe_state.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_compare_mode_valid() accepts exactly the eight evt[2:0] values
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_compare_mode_valid() shall return true for v in 0..7 and false for any value above 7.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() implements RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_EXACT
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() shall return true for mode RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_EXACT iff rx_len equals request_len and rx_data[0..rx_len) equals request_data[0..request_len) byte for byte, and false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() implements RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_PREFIX
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() shall return true for mode RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_PREFIX iff rx_len is at least request_len and the leading request_len bytes of rx_data equal request_data byte for byte, and false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() implements RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_ANY
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() shall return true for mode RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_ANY regardless of request_data/request_len/rx_data/rx_len.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() fails safe for RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_NEVER and every reserved mode
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_compare_fires() shall return false for mode RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_NEVER and for every RCP_EP_LIN_COMPARE_RESERVED4..RESERVED7 value, regardless of whether rx_data would otherwise satisfy an exact or prefix comparison against request_data.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_trigger_fires() evaluates the transmission-done trigger
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_trigger_fires() shall return false for trigger RCP_EP_LIN_TRIGGER_NONE regardless of tx_done_event, and shall return tx_done_event unchanged for trigger RCP_EP_LIN_TRIGGER_TX_DONE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes cfg
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_init() shall set every rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_t flag in cfg->common to false, cfg->lin_clk_divider to 0, and cfg->trigger to RCP_EP_LIN_TRIGGER_NONE (0), regardless of cfg's prior contents.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() denies every writer while HW_UNCONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for lifecycle state RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() allows every writer while HW_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() shall return true for lifecycle state RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_HW_CONFIGURED regardless of writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() requires authorization while RCP_CONFIGURED
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() shall return false for lifecycle state RCP_SERVER_LIFECYCLE_RCP_CONFIGURED when writer has neither via_root_client_ep0 nor via_owning_stream set, and true when either is set.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_set_clk_divider() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_set_clk_divider() shall leave cfg->lin_clk_divider unchanged and return false when rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() denies the write for the given state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_set_clk_divider() applies an authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_set_clk_divider() shall set cfg->lin_clk_divider to lin_clk_divider and return true when rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for the given state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_set_trigger() rejects an unauthorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_set_trigger() shall leave cfg->trigger unchanged and return false when rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() denies the write for the given state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_set_trigger() applies an authorized write
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_set_trigger() shall set cfg->trigger to trigger and return true when rcp_ep_lin_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for the given state/writer.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_strerror() returns a distinct, non-NULL message per error code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, and distinct string for each of RCP_EP_LIN_OK, RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME, RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE, RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_WRONG_BUS, and RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_WRONG_OP, and a non-NULL string for any other value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_encode_command_request() carries the raw payload and evt[2:0] compare_mode unmodified
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_encode_command_request() shall encode an ACF_ABB message addressed to byte_bus_id with op RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, evt[2:0] set to compare_mode, transaction_num set to transaction_num, and payload equal to tx_data[0..tx_len) byte for byte.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_decode_command_request() round-trips a valid command request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_decode_command_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_lin_encode_command_request() for byte_bus_id == expected_bus_id, return RCP_EP_LIN_OK and recover the raw tx payload, compare_mode, and transaction_num unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_decode_command_request() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_decode_command_request() shall return RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the ACF_ABB fixed header or its declared payload length, RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE when the frame is not an ACF_ABB message, RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id, and RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_encode_response() selects ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB by the timed flag
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_encode_response() shall encode an ACF_ABB message when timed is false, and an ACF_GBB message with message_timestamp set to timestamp and mtv RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID when timed is true, in both cases with op RCP_ACF_OP_READ, byte_bus_id set to byte_bus_id, transaction_num set to transaction_num, and payload equal to rx_data[0..rx_len) byte for byte.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() round-trips an untimed (ACF_ABB) response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_lin_encode_response() with timed false, return RCP_EP_LIN_OK, recover the rx payload and transaction_num unchanged, report out_timed false, and report out_timestamp 0.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() round-trips a timed (ACF_GBB) response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_lin_encode_response() with timed true, return RCP_EP_LIN_OK, recover the rx payload and transaction_num unchanged, report out_timed true, and report out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() rejects a malformed or misaddressed frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_lin_decode_response() shall return RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for its applicable ACF fixed header and RCP_EP_LIN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid() accepts exactly the six defined evt[2:0] values
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid() shall return true for v in 0..5 and false for any value above 5.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_is_xl() identifies the two CAN XL variants
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_is_xl() shall return true for RCP_EP_CAN_FRAME_XL_CLASSICAL_PL and RCP_EP_CAN_FRAME_XL_NEW_PL, and false for every other value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_id_width() reports the correct arbitration-id width per format
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_id_width() shall return RCP_EP_CAN_ID_WIDTH_EXTENDED_29 for RCP_EP_CAN_FRAME_CEFF and RCP_EP_CAN_FRAME_FEFF, and RCP_EP_CAN_ID_WIDTH_BASE_11 for every other value including an invalid format.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_arbitration_id_valid() bounds an identifier against its format's id width
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_arbitration_id_valid() shall return true iff format is rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid() and id does not exceed 0x7FF (BASE_11 formats) or 0x1FFFFFFF (EXTENDED_29 formats), and false for an invalid format regardless of id.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_max_data_len() reports each frame kind's own data ceiling
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_frame_format_max_data_len() shall return 8 for CBFF/CEFF, 64 for FBFF/FEFF, RCP_EP_CAN_XL_MAX_DATA_LEN (2048) for both CAN XL variants, and 0 for an invalid format.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_xl_filter_index_valid() accepts exactly the defined filter-table indices
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_xl_filter_index_valid() shall return true for index in 0..RCP_EP_CAN_XL_MAX_FILTERS-1 and false for index >= RCP_EP_CAN_XL_MAX_FILTERS.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes every functional-config field
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_init() shall zero cfg->common's flags, every bit-timing register set, delay_comp_enable/_offset, exec_delay_clk_divider, and every xl_filters[] entry.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() reuses server.h's field-writability authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() shall return exactly rcp_server_field_writable(state, RCP_SERVER_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W, writer).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_arbitration_timing() is gated by functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_arbitration_timing() shall apply timing to cfg->arbitration_timing and return true iff rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_fd_data_timing() is gated by functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_fd_data_timing() shall apply timing to cfg->fd_data_timing and return true iff rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_xl_data_timing() is gated by functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_xl_data_timing() shall apply timing to cfg->xl_data_timing and return true iff rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_delay_compensation() is gated by functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_delay_compensation() shall apply enable/offset to cfg->delay_comp_enable/cfg->delay_comp_offset and return true iff rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_exec_delay_clk_divider() is gated by functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_exec_delay_clk_divider() shall apply divider to cfg->exec_delay_clk_divider and return true iff rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_set_xl_filter() validates the filter index and functional-config authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_set_xl_filter() shall apply filter to cfg->xl_filters[index] and return true iff index is rcp_ep_can_xl_filter_index_valid() and rcp_ep_can_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes the write for state/writer, leaving cfg unchanged and returning false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_strerror() returns a non-null, distinct message for every error code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_strerror() shall return a non-null, non-empty string for every rcp_ep_can_errc_t value, distinct across all defined values, and a non-null string for an undefined value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_request() enforces frame-format, id, length, and xl_header preconditions
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t if frame_format is not rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid(), arbitration_id is not rcp_ep_can_arbitration_id_valid() for frame_format, tx_len exceeds rcp_ep_can_frame_format_max_data_len(frame_format), or xl_header's presence does not match rcp_ep_can_frame_format_is_xl(frame_format); otherwise it shall encode an ACF_ABB request carrying frame_format in evt[2:0] and this module's own arbitration-id/xl-header/data prefix layout.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_request() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or malformed-selector frame
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_request() shall return RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the ACF_ABB fixed header, its declared payload length, or this module's own frame_format-dependent prefix length; RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE if b is not an ACF_ABB message; RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id; RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_WRONG_OP when op is not RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE; and RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_BAD_FRAME_FORMAT when evt[2:0] is not rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_request() round-trips a well-formed frame's fields
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_request() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_request(), return RCP_EP_CAN_OK and recover frame_format, arbitration_id, xl_header (iff frame_format is a CAN XL variant), the tx data bytes, and transaction_num unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_response() enforces the same preconditions as the request encoder and supports timed/untimed encoding
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_response() shall apply the same frame-format/id/length/xl_header preconditions as rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_request() (substituting rx_data/rx_len), encoding as ACF_ABB when timed is false and as ACF_GBB with message_timestamp set to timestamp when timed is true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() rejects a malformed, misaddressed, or malformed-selector frame across both ACF_ABB and ACF_GBB
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() shall return RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the applicable fixed header, its declared payload length, or this module's own frame_format-dependent prefix length; RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_WRONG_BUS when byte_bus_id != expected_bus_id; and RCP_EP_CAN_ERR_BAD_FRAME_FORMAT when evt[2:0] is not rcp_ep_can_frame_format_valid(), regardless of whether the message is ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() reports timed/untimed status and timestamp correctly
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_response() with timed false, report out_timed false and out_timestamp 0; given one produced with timed true, report out_timed true and out_timestamp equal to the original timestamp.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() round-trips a well-formed frame's fields
requirements.text: rcp_ep_can_decode_frame_response() shall, given a frame produced by rcp_ep_can_encode_frame_response(), return RCP_EP_CAN_OK and recover frame_format, arbitration_id, xl_header (iff frame_format is a CAN XL variant), the rx data bytes, and transaction_num unchanged.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_encode() frames a nibble as a 5-bit even-parity symbol
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_encode() shall return a value in 0..31 whose bit 4 equals the even parity of bits [3:0], with bits [3:0] equal to the input nibble masked to its own low 4 bits.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_decode() validates a symbol's parity bit
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_decode() shall return true and set *out_nibble to bits [3:0] of the symbol iff bit 4 equals the even parity of bits [3:0], and shall return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_bitframe_encoded_len() reports two symbols per content octet
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_bitframe_encoded_len(data_len, append_crc) shall return 2 * (data_len + (append_crc ? 1 : 0)).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe() produces only valid, round-trippable symbols
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe() shall produce exactly rcp_ep_iseled_bitframe_encoded_len(data_len, append_crc) octets, each holding a value in 0..31 that rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_decode() accepts.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe() appends the CRC-8 trailer when append_crc is true
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe() shall, when append_crc is true, frame rcp_ep_iseled_crc8(data, data_len) as one extra trailing content octet after the data octets and before symbol expansion.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_crc8() is a deterministic, input-sensitive CRC-8
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_crc8() shall return the same value for the same input, shall return 0x00 for a zero-length input, and shall return a different value for two inputs that differ in content.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_requires_isp_n() reflects recovered-clock mode
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_requires_isp_n() shall return false iff use_rcv_clk is true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_trigger_fires() evaluates the single transmission-complete trigger
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_trigger_fires() shall return false for RCP_EP_ISELED_TRIGGER_NONE regardless of tx_complete_event, and for RCP_EP_ISELED_TRIGGER_TX_COMPLETE shall return the value of tx_complete_event.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes the functional config
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_init() shall set every rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_t flag false, iseled_bit_clk_divider to 0, iseled_use_rcv_clk and iseled_crc_enable to false, and trigger to RCP_EP_ISELED_TRIGGER_NONE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() wraps server.h's field-writability authorization
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() shall return the result of rcp_server_field_writable() called with kind RCP_SERVER_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_set_bit_clk_divider() is gated by functional-config writability
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_set_bit_clk_divider() shall apply the write and return true iff rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes it for the given state/writer, and shall leave cfg unchanged and return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_set_use_rcv_clk() is gated by functional-config writability
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_set_use_rcv_clk() shall apply the write and return true iff rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes it for the given state/writer, and shall leave cfg unchanged and return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_set_crc_enable() is gated by functional-config writability
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_set_crc_enable() shall apply the write and return true iff rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes it for the given state/writer, and shall leave cfg unchanged and return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_set_trigger() is gated by functional-config writability
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_set_trigger() shall apply the write and return true iff rcp_ep_iseled_functional_cfg_writable() authorizes it for the given state/writer, and shall leave cfg unchanged and return false otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_strerror() never returns NULL and is distinct per code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty string for every rcp_ep_iseled_errc_t value (including an unknown value), with a distinct string for each defined value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() rejects an odd symbol count
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() shall return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_ODD_SYMBOL_COUNT iff symbol_count is odd.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() rejects an invalid symbol
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() shall return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_BAD_SYMBOL iff any symbol in symbols[0..symbol_count) fails rcp_ep_iseled_symbol_decode().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() rejects too few symbols when a CRC trailer is expected
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() shall return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME iff expect_crc is true and symbol_count yields fewer than one reconstructed content octet.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() rejects a native ISELED CRC-8 mismatch
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() shall return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_CRC_MISMATCH iff expect_crc is true and the trailing reconstructed octet does not equal rcp_ep_iseled_crc8() of the preceding reconstructed octets.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() round-trips rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe()'s output
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_bitframe() shall, for symbols produced by rcp_ep_iseled_encode_bitframe(data, data_len, append_crc) with matching expect_crc, return RCP_EP_ISELED_OK and populate *out_data with exactly data[0..data_len).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_command_request() carries the caller's plain payload verbatim as ACF_OP_WRITE
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_command_request() shall encode an ACF_ABB frame addressed to byte_bus_id with op RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE and payload exactly tx_data[0..tx_len), unmodified.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_command_request() validates and decodes an ACF-level command request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_command_request() shall return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB header or its declared payload, RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame, RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id, RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_WRONG_OP for an op other than RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE, and otherwise RCP_EP_ISELED_OK with the plain payload and transaction number populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_response() encodes timed and untimed responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_encode_response() shall encode an ACF_GBB frame with message_timestamp set to timestamp and mtv RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID when timed is true, and an ACF_ABB frame otherwise, in both cases with payload exactly rx_data[0..rx_len) and op RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_response() validates and decodes either ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_iseled_decode_response() shall accept either an ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB frame, return RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the applicable header or declared payload, RCP_EP_ISELED_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id, and otherwise RCP_EP_ISELED_OK with the plain payload, transaction number, and timed/timestamp populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid() validates a Clause-22/Clause-45 MDIO address
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid() shall return false for any prtad above RCP_EP_MDIO_PRTAD_MAX, for a RCP_EP_MDIO_CLAUSE_22 address with a nonzero devad or a regad above RCP_EP_MDIO_CLAUSE22_REGAD_MAX, for a RCP_EP_MDIO_CLAUSE_45 address with devad above RCP_EP_MDIO_DEVAD_MAX, and for any other clause value; true otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_burst_next_regad() computes the next burst register address
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_burst_next_regad() shall return regad+1 wrapped modulo 32 for RCP_EP_MDIO_CLAUSE_22, regad+1 wrapped modulo 65536 for RCP_EP_MDIO_CLAUSE_45, and regad unchanged for any other clause value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_word_encode() encodes a 16-bit register word as two big-endian octets
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_word_encode() shall write word's high byte to out[0] and word's low byte to out[1].

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_word_decode() decodes two big-endian octets as a 16-bit register word
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_word_decode() shall return (in[0] << 8) | in[1].

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_pack_len() computes the packed byte length of a word count
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_pack_len() shall return word_count * 2.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_pack_words() packs a register-word array into a big-endian byte buffer
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_pack_words() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when word_count is 0 or on allocation failure, and otherwise a newly allocated buffer of rcp_ep_mdio_pack_len(word_count) octets holding each word's rcp_ep_mdio_word_encode() result in order.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_word_count_of() derives a word count from a packed byte length
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_word_count_of() shall return false and leave *out_word_count untouched when byte_len is odd, and otherwise return true with *out_word_count set to byte_len / 2.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_unpack_word_at() reads one packed register word by index
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_unpack_word_at() shall return rcp_ep_mdio_word_decode() applied to data[2*word_index .. 2*word_index+2).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes an MDIO functional config
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_functional_cfg_init() shall zero-initialize cfg and initialize cfg->common via rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_init(), leaving every common flag false.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_functional_cfg_writable() delegates to the shared field-authorization logic
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_functional_cfg_writable() shall return rcp_server_field_writable(state, RCP_SERVER_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W, writer).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_strerror() returns a non-NULL message for every error code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty, distinct message for each rcp_ep_mdio_errc_t value, and a non-NULL message for any unrecognized value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_read_request() encodes an ACF_ABB MDIO read request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_read_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when !rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid(addr) or word_count is 0 or exceeds RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS, and otherwise encode an ACF_ABB message with op RCP_ACF_OP_READ whose payload is addr's clause/prtad/devad/regad fields followed by word_count, all as specified.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_read_request() validates and decodes an ACF-level MDIO read request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_read_request() shall return RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB header, its declared payload, or the 7-byte request prefix; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_OP for an op other than RCP_ACF_OP_READ; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_ADDR when the decoded address fails rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid(); RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_WORD_COUNT when the decoded word_count is 0 or exceeds RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS; and otherwise RCP_EP_MDIO_OK with the address, word count, and transaction number populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_read_response() encodes timed and untimed MDIO read responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_read_response() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when word_count exceeds RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS or on allocation failure, and otherwise encode an ACF_GBB frame with message_timestamp set to timestamp and mtv RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID when timed is true, or an ACF_ABB frame otherwise, in both cases with payload rcp_ep_mdio_pack_words(words, word_count) and op RCP_ACF_OP_READ.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_read_response() validates and decodes either ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB MDIO read responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_read_response() shall accept either an ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB frame, return RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the applicable header or declared payload, RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id, RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_WORD_COUNT for an odd payload length or more than RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS words, and otherwise RCP_EP_MDIO_OK with the packed word bytes, word count, transaction number, and timed/timestamp populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_write_request() encodes an ACF_ABB MDIO write request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_write_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when !rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid(addr), word_count is 0 or exceeds RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS, or on allocation failure, and otherwise encode an ACF_ABB message with op RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE whose payload is addr's clause/prtad/devad/regad fields followed by rcp_ep_mdio_pack_words(words, word_count).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_write_request() validates and decodes an ACF-level MDIO write request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_write_request() shall return RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB header, its declared payload, or the 5-byte address prefix; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_OP for an op other than RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE; RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_ADDR when the decoded address fails rcp_ep_mdio_addr_valid(); RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_WORD_COUNT when the trailing words region's byte length is odd, is 0, or represents more than RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS words; and otherwise RCP_EP_MDIO_OK with the address, packed word bytes, word count, and transaction number populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_write_response() encodes timed and untimed MDIO write responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_encode_write_response() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when accepted_word_count exceeds RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS or on allocation failure, and otherwise encode an ACF_GBB frame with message_timestamp set to timestamp and mtv RCP_ACF_MTV_VALID when timed is true, or an ACF_ABB frame otherwise, in both cases with payload rcp_ep_mdio_pack_words(accepted_words, accepted_word_count) and op RCP_ACF_OP_WRITE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_write_response() validates and decodes either ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB MDIO write responses
requirements.text: rcp_ep_mdio_decode_write_response() shall accept either an ACF_ABB or ACF_GBB frame, return RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame too short for the applicable header or declared payload, RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id, RCP_EP_MDIO_ERR_BAD_WORD_COUNT for an odd payload length or more than RCP_EP_MDIO_MAX_BURST_WORDS words, and otherwise RCP_EP_MDIO_OK with the accepted packed word bytes, word count, transaction number, and timed/timestamp populated.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_string() returns a unique human-readable name
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_string() shall return a unique, non-empty name for each defined rcp_pwrmode_t constant, and a non-NULL name for any other value.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_strerror() returns a non-NULL message for every error code
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty message for each rcp_pwrmode_errc_t value, and a non-NULL message for any unrecognized value.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_cold_start_lifecycle_target() names the cold-start re-init target
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_cold_start_lifecycle_target() shall return RCP_LIFECYCLE_HW_UNCONFIGURED.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_transition() implements the general power-mode transition table
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_transition() shall succeed with RCP_PWRMODE_START_HOT for Normal<->StandBy and for a mode transitioning to itself; shall succeed with RCP_PWRMODE_START_COLD for Normal/StandBy->Sleep, any mode->Unpowered, and Unpowered->Normal; and shall fail with RCP_PWRMODE_ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION (leaving *mode unchanged) for Sleep->Normal and for any other transition not named above.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_hotstart_required() identifies the network-wake handshake bypass
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_hotstart_required() shall return false for RCP_PWRMODE_WAKE_VIA_NETWORK and true for RCP_PWRMODE_WAKE_VIA_PIN.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_init() sets the initial handshake state
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_init() shall set hs->step to RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_NOT_STARTED, hs->wakeup_attempts to 0, and hs->wakeup_repeat_limit to repeat_limit.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_iface_reenabled() implements handshake step (a)
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_iface_reenabled() shall, when hs->step == RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_NOT_STARTED, advance hs->step to RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_IFACE_REENABLED and return true; otherwise it shall leave hs unchanged and return false.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_wakeup_attempt() implements handshake step (b)
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_wakeup_attempt() shall, when hs->step != RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_IFACE_REENABLED, leave hs unchanged and return false; otherwise it shall increment hs->wakeup_attempts, and if echoed is true advance hs->step to RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_ECHOED and return true, else if hs->wakeup_attempts has reached hs->wakeup_repeat_limit advance hs->step to RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_FAILED and return false, else leave hs->step unchanged and return true.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_resume_queues() implements handshake step (c)
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_resume_queues() shall, when hs->step == RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_ECHOED, advance hs->step to RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_COMPLETE and return true; otherwise it shall leave hs unchanged and return false.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_is_complete() reports handshake completion
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_is_complete() shall return true iff hs->step == RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_COMPLETE.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_has_failed() reports handshake failure
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_handshake_has_failed() shall return true iff hs->step == RCP_PWRMODE_HANDSHAKE_FAILED.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_wake_from_sleep() classifies hot vs. cold wake starts
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_wake_from_sleep() shall fail with RCP_PWRMODE_ERR_INVALID_TRANSITION when *mode != RCP_PWRMODE_SLEEP; otherwise it shall set *mode to RCP_PWRMODE_NORMAL and report *out_start_kind as RCP_PWRMODE_START_HOT when !rcp_pwrmode_hotstart_required(path) or when handshake is non-NULL and rcp_pwrmode_handshake_is_complete(handshake), and as RCP_PWRMODE_START_COLD otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_pwrmode_check_entry() gates StandBy/Sleep entry requests
requirements.text: rcp_pwrmode_check_entry() shall return RCP_PWRMODE_ENTRY_REFUSED when gate is NULL or any of gate->wup_status_clear, gate->endpoint_idle, gate->response_queue_empty is false, and RCP_PWRMODE_ENTRY_OK otherwise.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_functional_cfg_init() zero-initializes a wakeup functional config
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_functional_cfg_init() shall zero-initialize cfg (including every sources[] entry) and initialize cfg->common via rcp_regmap_ep_functional_cfg_init().

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_functional_cfg_writable() delegates to the shared field-authorization logic
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_functional_cfg_writable() shall return rcp_lifecycle_field_writable(state, RCP_LIFECYCLE_FIELD_FUNCTIONAL_W, writer).

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_source_asserted() applies one source's own polarity
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_source_asserted() shall return true iff cfg.enabled is true and pin_level equals cfg.active_high.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_any_source_asserted() reports whether any configured source is asserted
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_any_source_asserted() shall return false when fcfg is NULL or when pin_levels is NULL with pin_level_count > 0, and otherwise return true iff rcp_ep_wakeup_source_asserted() is true for at least one of the first min(pin_level_count, RCP_EP_WAKEUP_MAX_SOURCES) source/pin_level pairs.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_init() clears the wup_status latch
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_init() shall set s->latched to false.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_latch() sets the wup_status latch
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_latch() shall set s->latched to true.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_clear() clears the wup_status latch
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_clear() shall set s->latched to false.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_is_clear() reports the wup_status latch's state
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_wup_status_is_clear() shall return !s->latched.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_strerror() returns a non-NULL message for every error code
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_strerror() shall return a non-NULL, non-empty message for each rcp_ep_wakeup_errc_t value, and a non-NULL message for any unrecognized value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_sleepcmd_request() encodes a fixed-opcode SleepCMD request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_sleepcmd_request() shall return a zeroed rcp_bytes_t when target_mode is neither RCP_PWRMODE_STANDBY nor RCP_PWRMODE_SLEEP, and otherwise encode an ACF_ABB message with op RCP_ACF_OP_NONE whose 2-byte payload is RCP_EP_WAKEUP_SLEEPCMD_OPCODE followed by target_mode's raw value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_sleepcmd_request() validates and decodes a SleepCMD request
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_sleepcmd_request() shall return RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB header or its declared 2-byte payload; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_BAD_OPCODE when the first payload byte is not RCP_EP_WAKEUP_SLEEPCMD_OPCODE; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_BAD_TARGET_MODE when the second payload byte is neither RCP_PWRMODE_STANDBY nor RCP_PWRMODE_SLEEP; and otherwise RCP_EP_WAKEUP_OK with the target mode and transaction number populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_sleepcmd_response() encodes a fixed-opcode SleepCMD response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_sleepcmd_response() shall encode an ACF_ABB message with op RCP_ACF_OP_NONE whose 2-byte payload is RCP_EP_WAKEUP_SLEEPCMD_OPCODE followed by result's raw value, echoing transaction_num.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_sleepcmd_response() validates and decodes a SleepCMD response
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_sleepcmd_response() shall apply the same short-frame/wrong-message-type/wrong-bus/bad-opcode failure modes as rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_sleepcmd_request(), and on RCP_EP_WAKEUP_OK shall set *out_result to RCP_PWRMODE_ENTRY_OK only when the second payload byte equals RCP_PWRMODE_ENTRY_OK's own raw value, and to RCP_PWRMODE_ENTRY_REFUSED for every other byte value.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_wakeup_message() encodes a fixed-opcode WakeUp message
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_encode_wakeup_message() shall encode an ACF_ABB message with op RCP_ACF_OP_NONE whose 1-byte payload is RCP_EP_WAKEUP_WAKEUP_OPCODE.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_wakeup_message() validates and decodes a WakeUp message
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_wakeup_message() shall return RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_SHORT_FRAME for a frame shorter than the ACF_ABB header or its declared 1-byte payload; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_BAD_MSG_TYPE for a non-ACF_ABB frame; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_WRONG_BUS for a mismatched byte_bus_id; RCP_EP_WAKEUP_ERR_BAD_OPCODE when the payload byte is not RCP_EP_WAKEUP_WAKEUP_OPCODE; and otherwise RCP_EP_WAKEUP_OK with the transaction number populated.

requirements.title: rcp_ep_wakeup_is_wakeup_echo() recognizes a matching WakeUp echo
requirements.text: rcp_ep_wakeup_is_wakeup_echo() shall return true iff rcp_ep_wakeup_decode_wakeup_message() succeeds on b[0..len) against expected_bus_id and the decoded transaction number equals sent_transaction_num, and false otherwise.
